title.zh: 卷9 本紀九 世宗本紀
title.raw: 卷9 本紀九 世宗本紀

sentences.zh: 世宗敬天昌運建中表正文武英明寬仁信毅睿聖大孝至誠憲皇帝諱胤禛，聖祖第四子也。

translations.literal: The Shizong Emperor, styled Jingtian Changyun Jianzhong Biaozheng Wenwu Yingming Kuanren Xinyi Ruisheng Daxiao Zhicheng Xian, personal name Yinzhen, was the fourth son of the Sage Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong (Yongzheng), temple name Yinzhen, was Kangxi's fourth son.

sentences.zh: 母孝恭仁皇后烏雅氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Xiaogongren of the Uya clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Xiaogongren (Uya).

sentences.zh: 生有異徵，天表魁偉，舉止端凝。

translations.literal: At birth there were auspicious signs; his bearing was imposing and his deportment grave and composed.
translations.idiomatic: Portents attended his birth; he was tall and dignified in manner.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十七年封貝勒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Kangxi he was enfeoffed as a beile.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 37 he received the rank of beile.

sentences.zh: 四十八年封雍親王。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he was enfeoffed as Prince Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 48 he became Prince Yong.

sentences.zh: 六十一年十一月，聖祖在暢春園不豫，命代祀圜丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the sixty-first year, when the Sage Ancestor fell ill at the Changchun Garden, Yinzhen was ordered to perform the suburban sacrifice at the Round Altar in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 of Kangxi 61, as Kangxi lay ill at Changchun Garden, Yinzhen was sent to offer the suburban sacrifice at the Round Altar.

sentences.zh: 甲午，聖祖大漸，召於齋宮，宣詔嗣位。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, as the Sage Ancestor's illness grew critical, he was summoned to the fasting palace and the edict of succession was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, with Kangxi near death, Yinzhen was called to the fasting palace and proclaimed heir.

sentences.zh: 聖祖崩。

translations.literal: The Sage Ancestor died.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上即位，以明年為雍正元年。

translations.literal: On day xinchou the Emperor acceded; the following year was taken as the first year of Yongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Yinzhen took the throne; the next year began the Yongzheng reign.

sentences.zh: 命貝勒胤禩、皇十三弟胤祥、大學士馬齊、尚書隆科多總理事務。

translations.literal: Prince Yinsi, the thirteenth imperial brother Yinxiang, Grand Secretary Ma Qi, and Minister Longkodo were ordered to manage state affairs jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Yinsi, Yinxiang, Ma Qi, and Longkodo were put in charge of government.

sentences.zh: 召撫遠大將軍胤禵來京。

translations.literal: The Pacification General of the Far Regions Yinti was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yinti, Pacification General on the western frontier, was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命兵部尚書白潢協理大學士。

translations.literal: Minister of War Bai Huang was ordered to assist the Grand Secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Huang of the Board of War was ordered to assist the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以楊宗仁為湖廣總督，年希堯署廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Yang Zongren was made governor-general of Huguang; Nian Xiyao acted as Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zongren became Huguang governor-general; Nian Xiyao served as acting Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，停止直省貢獻方物。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu: tribute goods from the provinces were halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuwu day, provincial tribute offerings were stopped.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，封貝勒胤禩為廉親王，胤祥為怡親王，胤祹為履郡王，廢太子胤礽之子弘晰為理郡王。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Prince Yinsi was enfeoffed as Prince Lian, Yinxiang as Prince Yi, Yintao as Prince of the Commandery of Lu, and Hongxi, son of the deposed Crown Prince Yinreng, as Prince of the Commandery of Li.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Yinsi became Prince Lian, Yinxiang Prince Yi, Yintao Prince of Lu, and Hongxi—Yinreng's son—Prince of Li.

sentences.zh: 更定歷代帝王廟祀典。

translations.literal: The ritual canon for sacrifices at the Temple of Former Emperors was revised.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial regulations for the Temple of Former Emperors were revised.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔古今圖書集成一書尚未竣事，宜速舉淵通之士編輯成書。

translations.literal: On day guihai, an edict said the Comprehensive Mirror of Ancient and Modern Books was not yet finished and scholars of broad learning should be quickly selected to complete the compilation.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, an edict urged swift completion of the Gujin Tushu Jicheng encyclopedia.

sentences.zh: 以輔國公延信為西安將軍，署撫遠大將軍事。

translations.literal: Assistant State Duke Yanxin was made general at Xi'an and acted as Pacification General of the Far Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxin became Xi'an general and acting Pacification General.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔直省倉庫虧空，限三年補足，逾限治罪。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict ordered that provincial treasury deficits be made up within three years, with punishment beyond the deadline.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, provinces were given three years to cover warehouse shortfalls or face punishment.

sentences.zh: 命富寧安為大學士，隆科多為吏部尚書，廉親王胤禩管理籓院尚書事。

translations.literal: Funing'an was made Grand Secretary, Longkodo Minister of Personnel, and Prince Lian Yinsi put in charge of the Board of Imperial Clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: Funing'an became Grand Secretary; Longkodo, Minister of Personnel; Yinsi managed the Clansmen Board.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以張廷玉為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Zhang Tingyu was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Zhang Tingyu became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 予大學士馬齊二等伯爵，賜名敦惠。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ma Qi was granted a second-rank earldom and given the honor name Dunhui.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi received a second-rank earldom and the honor name Dunhui.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年癸卯春正月辛巳朔，頒詔訓飭督、撫、提、鎮，文吏至於守、令，武將至於參、游，凡十一道。

translations.literal: First year of Yongzheng, spring, first month, day xinsi, new year's day: edicts admonishing governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and garrison commanders, down to prefects and magistrates among civil officials and colonels and battalion commanders among military officers—eleven edicts in all.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's day of Yongzheng 1, eleven admonitory edicts went out to every level of civil and military official.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，時享太廟。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, seasonal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the seasonal offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祈穀於上帝。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, grain prayer to the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor prayed for grain to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，頒賜提、鎮、副將大行遺念弓矢橐鞬。

translations.literal: On day renyin, bows, arrows, and quivers from the late Emperor's bequest were distributed to provincial commanders, garrison commanders, and deputy generals.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Kangxi's parting gifts of bow and quiver were bestowed on senior field commanders.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書陶賴、張廷樞坐審訊陳夢雷一案釋其二子，降官。

translations.literal: Ministers of Justice Tao Lai and Zhang Tingshu were demoted for releasing Chen Menglei's two sons during trial of his case.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Lai and Zhang Tingshu were demoted for freeing Chen Menglei's sons during his trial.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，封淳郡王子弘曙為長子、弘春為貝子。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Hongshu and Hongchun, sons of Prince Chun of the Commandery, were enfeoffed as eldest son and beizi respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Hongshu and Hongchun, sons of Prince Chun, became eldest son and beizi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，大學士王掞乞休，允之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Grand Secretary Wang Yan asked to retire; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Grand Secretary Wang Yan retired with approval.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥朔，以佛格、勵廷儀為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinhai, new moon: Foge and Li Tingyi were made Ministers of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the second month, Foge and Li Tingyi became Ministers of Justice.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以張鵬翮為大學士。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Zhang Penghe was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Zhang Penghe became Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以皇十六弟胤祿出嗣庄親王博果鐸，襲其爵。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the sixteenth imperial brother Yinlu was adopted into the line of Prince Zhuang Boguoduo and inherited his rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Yinlu succeeded Prince Zhuang Boguoduo by adoption.

sentences.zh: 以博果鐸之侄球琳為貝勒。

translations.literal: Boguoduo's nephew Qiulin was made a beile.
translations.idiomatic: Qiulin, Boguoduo's nephew, received the rank of beile.

sentences.zh: 庚申，訓飭貝子胤禟。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Prince Yintang was admonished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Prince Yintang was publicly rebuked.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，封輔國公延信為貝子。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Assistant State Duke Yanxin was enfeoffed as beizi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Yanxin was raised to beizi.

sentences.zh: 定部院書吏考滿回籍聽選例。

translations.literal: Regulations were fixed for ministry clerks who, on completing service examination, return home for selection.
translations.idiomatic: Rules were set for ministry clerks to return home after passing service review.

sentences.zh: 敕科道官每日一人具摺奏事。

translations.literal: Censors were ordered that one person each day submit a memorial-fold report on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: One censor each day was required to submit a folded memorial.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以宜兆熊為福州將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Yi Zhaoxiong was made general at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Yi Zhaoxiong became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 趙之垣免，以李維鈞為直隸巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhao Zhiyuan was dismissed; Li Weijun was made Zhili governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zhiyuan left office; Li Weijun became Zhili governor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，副將軍阿喇衲奏羅卜腦兒回人投順。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Deputy General Alana reported that Muslims of Lobnor had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Alana reported submission of the Lobnor Muslims.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，罷西藏防兵戍察木多。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen: Tibetan garrison troops at Chamdo were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiashen day, the Chamdo garrison in Tibet was recalled.

sentences.zh: 加隆科多、馬齊、年羹堯太保。

translations.literal: Longkodo, Ma Qi, and Nian Gengyao were promoted to Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Longkodo, Ma Qi, and Nian Gengyao received the rank of Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 命督撫疏薦幕賓。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors were ordered to recommend staff in memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial governors were told to recommend advisers in memorials.

sentences.zh: 封年羹堯三等公。

translations.literal: Nian Gengyao was enfeoffed as Duke of the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao was made a third-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命故安和親王岳樂之孫吳爾占、色亨圖、經希及其子移居盛京，除屬籍。

translations.literal: On day renchen, grandsons of the late Prince Anhe Yuele—Wuerzhan, Sehengtu, Jingxi, and their sons—were ordered to move to Mukden and were struck from the imperial clan register.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Yuele's grandsons and their sons were sent to Mukden and removed from the clan rolls.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，大行梓宮奉安饗殿，命貝子胤禵留護。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinhai: the late Emperor's coffin was installed in the mourning hall; Prince Yinti was ordered to remain on guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Kangxi's coffin was placed in the mourning hall; Yinti was left to guard it.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命怡親王胤祥總理戶部，封其子弘昌為貝子。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Prince Yi Yinxiang was ordered to manage the Board of Revenue; his son Hongchang was enfeoffed as beizi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Yinxiang took charge of the Board of Revenue; his son Hongchang became beizi.

sentences.zh: 設鄉、會試繙譯科。

translations.literal: Translation examination subjects were established for provincial and metropolitan examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu translation tracks were added to the provincial and metropolitan exams.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復置起居注官。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Daily Records officials were reinstated.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the office of the Daily Records was restored.

sentences.zh: 封皇十七弟胤禮為果郡王。

translations.literal: The seventeenth imperial brother Yinzhi was enfeoffed as Prince of the Commandery of Guo.
translations.idiomatic: The seventeenth brother, Yinzhi, became Prince of Guo.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，初御乾清門聽政。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, for the first time he held court at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor heard affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Purity for the first time.

sentences.zh: 制詔訓飭大學士、領侍衛內大臣、文武大臣凡三道。

translations.literal: Imperial proclamations admonishing Grand Secretaries, leading grand chamberlains, and civil and military ministers—three in all.
translations.idiomatic: Three admonitory proclamations were issued to the highest civil and military ministers.

sentences.zh: 丙子，晉封淳郡王胤祐為親王。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Prince Chun of the Commandery Yinwu was promoted to full prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Yinwu was raised from commandery prince to full prince.

sentences.zh: 敕總兵官具摺言事。

translations.literal: Regional commanders were ordered to submit memorial-folds on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders were required to report by folded memorial.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，詔免雲南入藏兵丁應補倒斃馬匹。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengchen: an edict remitted Yunnan troops' obligation to replace horses that died on the Tibet route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengchen day, Yunnan soldiers were excused from replacing horses lost on the road to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，御太和殿視朝。

translations.literal: On day guimao, he held audience at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor held formal audience at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 李維鈞請以州縣歲入彌補積虧。

translations.literal: Li Weijun asked to use annual prefectural and county revenue to cover accumulated deficits.
translations.idiomatic: Li Weijun proposed covering treasury shortfalls from local annual revenue.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「州縣官令少從容，方可責之盡心興舉，豈可勒為他人補虧缺耶！

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Prefects and magistrates should be given some leeway before they can be expected to devote themselves fully to good administration—how can they be compelled to make up others' deficits!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused: local officials need breathing room to govern well; they cannot be forced to pay off someone else's debts.

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，敕理郡王弘晰移住鄭家莊。

translations.literal: "" (closing quotation mark in the source.) On day yiyou, an edict ordered Prince of the Commandery of Li Hongxi to move to Zhengjiazhuang.
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued. On yiyou day, Hongxi was ordered to reside at Zhengjiazhuang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命尚書徐元夢署大學士。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Minister Xu Yuanmeng was ordered to act as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Xu Yuanmeng served as acting Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，仁壽皇太后崩，帝之生母也，奉安梓宮於寧壽宮。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Empress Dowager Renshou died—she was the Emperor's birth mother; the coffin was placed at Ningshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor's mother, Empress Dowager Renshou, died; her coffin rested at Ningshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 封貝子胤禵為恂郡王。

translations.literal: Prince Yinti was enfeoffed as Prince of the Commandery of Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Yinti was raised to Prince of Xun.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，以左世永為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: Zuo Shiyong was made Han Chinese commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingsi day, Zuo Shiyong became Han commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己未，加封孔子五世王爵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the five generations of Confucius were granted princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, five generations of Confucius' line received princely titles.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命八旗無恆產者移居熱河墾田。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, banner people without fixed property were ordered to move to Rehe to open farmland.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, landless bannermen were sent to Rehe to farm.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，青海郡王額爾得尼為羅卜藏丹津所破，率屬來投，遣官撫之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Qinghai prince Erdeni, broken by Lobsang Danjin, came in submission with his followers; officials were sent to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Qinghai prince, defeated by Lobsang Danjin, fled in with his people and received imperial care.

sentences.zh: 其侄噶爾丹達錫續來歸附，命同居於蘇油。

translations.literal: His nephew Galdan Tashi also came to submit; they were ordered to dwell together at Suyou.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew Galdan Tashi followed; both groups were settled at Suyou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，敕李維鈞：「畿甸之內，旗民雜處，旗人暴橫，頗苦小民。

translations.literal: On day renshen, an edict to Li Weijun said: "Within the capital region, banner people and commoners live mingled; bannermen's violence has greatly troubled the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Li Weijun was told that banner bullying of commoners in the capital region must be stopped.

sentences.zh: 爾當整飭，不必避忌旗、漢形跡，畏懼王公勛戚，皆密奏以聞。

translations.literal: You must rectify this; do not avoid the distinction between banner and Han, or fear princes and meritorious nobles—all are to be reported in secret memorials.
translations.idiomatic: He was to act without regard to banner privilege or noble rank and report abuses secretly.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，敕八旗人員有為本旗都統、本管王公刁難苛索者，許其控訴。

translations.literal: "" (closing quotation mark in the source.) On day bingzi, banner personnel who suffered extortion from their banner commander or supervising prince were permitted to lodge complaints.
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued. On bingzi day, bannermen could sue commanders or princes who oppressed them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，命侍郎常壽諭和羅卜藏丹津。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jimao: Vice Minister Chang Shou was sent to negotiate with Lobsang Danjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jimao day, Chang Shou was dispatched to treat with Lobsang Danjin.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣官赴盛京、江西、湖廣糶米運京。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, officers were sent to Mukden, Jiangxi, and Huguang to sell grain and ship it to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, grain was purchased in Mukden, Jiangxi, and Huguang for transport to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔免江西漕糧腳耗運費誤追者。

translations.literal: On day jichou, an edict remitted wrongly collected transport fees and porter surcharges on Jiangxi tribute grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, excess charges on Jiangxi grain transport were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，改國語固山額真為固山昂邦，伊都額真為伊都章京。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Manchu titles gushan ejen and idu ejen were changed to gushan angbang and idu zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Manchu banner officer titles were renamed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，停本年秋決。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, autumn executions were suspended for this year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the autumn executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 除紹興惰民丐籍。

translations.literal: The beggar registry of indolent households in Shaoxing was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing's hereditary beggar caste was struck from the registers.

sentences.zh: 頒行孝經衍義。

translations.literal: The Expanded Meaning of the Classic of Filial Piety was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiaojing yanyi was issued throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命隆科多、王頊齡監修明史，徐元夢、張廷玉為總裁。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Longkodo and Wang Yuling were ordered to supervise compilation of the History of Ming, with Xu Yuanmeng and Zhang Tingyu as chief editors.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Longkodo and Wang Yuling oversaw the Ming History; Xu Yuanmeng and Zhang Tingyu led the editorial staff.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，以楊琳為廣東總督，孔毓珣為廣西總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingsi: Yang Lin was made Guangdong governor-general; Kong Yuqi Guangxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi day, Yang Lin and Kong Yuqi received southern posts.

sentences.zh: 甲子，召王大臣九卿面諭之曰：「建儲一事，理宜夙定。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, princes, ministers, and the Nine Ministers were summoned for face-to-face instruction: "The matter of establishing an heir ought long ago to have been settled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Emperor told his highest ministers that the succession should have been settled earlier.

sentences.zh: 去年十一月之事，倉卒之間，一言而定。

translations.literal: Last November's affair was decided in a single word amid haste.
translations.idiomatic: Last November's choice was made in a moment of crisis.

sentences.zh: 聖祖神聖，非朕所及。

translations.literal: The Sage Ancestor was divine in wisdom—beyond what We can match.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi's wisdom surpassed his own.

sentences.zh: 今朕親寫密封，緘置錦匣，藏於正大光明匾額之後，諸卿其識之。

translations.literal: Now We have personally written a sealed document, placed in a brocade casket and hidden behind the plaque "Upright and Illuminating"; you ministers are to take note of it.
translations.idiomatic: He had written the heir's name, sealed it in a casket behind the "Upright and Illuminating" plaque, and bade them remember.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，常壽疏報行抵青海，諭和羅卜藏丹津，不從。

translations.literal: "" (closing quotation mark in the source.) On day gengwu, Chang Shou memorialized that he had reached Qinghai and negotiated with Lobsang Danjin, who would not comply.
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued. On gengwu day, Chang Shou reported that Lobsang Danjin refused negotiation at Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 詔年羹堯備兵。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Nian Gengyao to prepare troops.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao was ordered to ready his forces.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Emperor went to the tombs.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑朔，葬聖祖仁皇帝於景陵，孝恭皇后祔焉。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou, new moon: the Sage Ancestor Ren Emperor was buried at Jingling; Empress Xiaogong was enshrined with him.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the ninth month, Kangxi was buried at Jingling with Empress Xiaogong.

sentences.zh: 是日，五色雲見。

translations.literal: That day, five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: A five-colored cloud was seen that day.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以郝玉麟為雲南提督。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Hao Yulin was made Yunnan provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Hao Yulin became Yunnan provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以張廷玉為戶部尚書，張伯行為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Zhang Tingyu was made Minister of Revenue; Zhang Boxing Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Zhang Tingyu took Revenue; Zhang Boxing, Rites.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以裕親王保泰管鑲黃旗事務。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Prince Yu Bao Tai was put in charge of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Prince Yu Bao Tai managed the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 命纂修律例。

translations.literal: An order was issued to compile and revise the legal code.
translations.idiomatic: Work on revising the legal code was ordered.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以阿喇衲為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Alana was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Alana became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，敕授年羹堯撫遠大將軍，改延信為平逆將軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wushen: Nian Gengyao was appointed Pacification General of the Far Regions; Yanxin was changed to Pacification General for Suppressing Rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wushen day, Nian Gengyao became Pacification General; Yanxin, Pacification General against Rebels.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，羅卜藏丹津執我使臣常壽，筆帖式多爾濟死之。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Lobsang Danjin seized our envoy Chang Shou; clerk Dorji died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Lobsang Danjin seized Chang Shou and killed clerk Dorji.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以阿爾松阿為禮部尚書，尹泰為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Arsonga was made Minister of Rites; Yin Tai Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Arsonga and Yin Tai received new posts.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，賜于振等二百四十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou: Yu Zhen and two hundred forty-six others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingchou day, Yu Zhen and 246 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，羅卜藏丹津入寇西寧，守備馬有仁、參將宋可進敗之於申中堡，賊遁。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Lobsang Danjin raided Xining; garrison commander Ma Youren and Regional Commander Song Kejin defeated him at Shenzhong Fort; the rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Lobsang Danjin attacked Xining and was beaten back at Shenzhong Fort.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，年羹堯奏總兵楊盡信進剿番賊於庄浪椅子山，斬賊數百。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Nian Gengyao memorialized that Regional Commander Yang Jinxin advanced against Tibetan rebels at Zhuanglang Chair Mountain and beheaded several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Nian Gengyao reported Yang Jinxin's victory at Zhuanglang, with hundreds of rebels slain.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: Imperial commendation was received.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial received imperial praise.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，冬至，祀天於圜丘，奉聖祖仁皇帝配享。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, at the winter solstice, Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound Altar, with Emperor Shengzu Ren accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, at the winter solstice, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound, with the Kangxi Emperor as associate spirit.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午朔，以吳爾占等怨望，不準承襲安郡王，並撤所屬佐領。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day of the month on day bingwu: because Wu Erzhan and others showed resentment, they were not permitted to inherit the title Prince of An commandery, and their attached commanders were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the twelfth month, Wu Erzhan and others were barred from inheriting the Prince of An title and lost their attached commanders for disloyalty.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，年羹堯奏賊人來犯，參將孫繼宗擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Nian Gengyao reported that bandits had come to attack; Assistant Commander Sun Jizong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Nian Gengyao reported an attack; Assistant Commander Sun Jizong drove the raiders off.

sentences.zh: 安插洋人於澳門，改天主堂為公所，嚴禁入教。

translations.literal: Foreigners were settled at Macao; the Catholic church was converted to a public hall, and joining the religion was strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Westerners were settled at Macao, the Catholic church was turned into a public hall, and conversion was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，冊嫡妃那拉氏為皇后，封年氏為貴妃，鈕祜祿氏為熹妃，耿氏為裕嬪。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the principal consort of the Nara clan was invested as empress; the Nian clan was made Noble Consort, the Niuhuru clan Honored Consort Xi, and the Geng clan Pure Concubine Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Empress Nara was installed, with Noble Consort Nian, Honored Consort Xi Niuhuru, and Pure Concubine Yu Geng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the seasonal great offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor performed the collective ancestral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南等省四十九州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for forty-nine prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas across forty-nine districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁戶二千五百三十二萬六千二百七十，又永不加賦後滋生人丁四十八萬五百五十七。

translations.literal: Registered households numbered 25,326,270, and additionally 480,557 persons registered after the perpetual exemption from additional levies.
translations.idiomatic: The census counted 25,326,270 households and 480,557 persons registered after the perpetual no-new-levy rule.

sentences.zh: 田賦徵銀三千二十二萬三千九百四十三兩有奇。

translations.literal: Land tax collected 30,223,943 taels odd.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax yielded 30,223,943 taels and a fraction.

sentences.zh: 鹽課銀四百二十六萬一千九百三十三兩有奇。

translations.literal: Salt tax 4,261,933 taels odd.
translations.idiomatic: The salt levy brought 4,261,933 taels and a fraction.

sentences.zh: 鑄錢四十九萬九千二百有奇。

translations.literal: Coinage 499,200 odd.
translations.idiomatic: Coin was cast to the amount of 499,200 and a fraction.

sentences.zh: 二年甲辰春正月辛巳，祈穀於上帝，奉聖祖仁皇帝配享。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day xinsi: grain-and-meat offering to the Supreme Lord, with Emperor Shengzu Ren accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the first day of spring, the Emperor offered grain and meat to Heaven, with the Kangxi Emperor as associate spirit.

sentences.zh: 詔大學士圖海配享太廟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Grand Secretary Tulai to share in the great offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Tulai was ordered to share in the ancestral temple offering.

sentences.zh: 常壽自羅卜藏丹津處回，命監禁西安。

translations.literal: Chang Shou returned from Lobsang Danjin's side and was ordered confined at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Shou came back from Lobsang Danjin and was imprisoned at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命岳鍾琪為奮威將軍，專征青海。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Yue Zhongqi was made Valiant and Majestic General and given sole command of the Qinghai expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Yue Zhongqi became Valiant and Majestic General with sole command in Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以高其佩為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Gao Qipei was made Han Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Gao Qipei became Han Banner commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，建孔子廟于歸化城。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, a Confucian temple was built at Guihua Town.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, a Confucian temple was erected at Guihua Town.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，御制聖諭廣訓，頒行天下。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingwu: the Emperor composed the Sacred Edict for Extensive Instruction and promulgated it throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor issued his Sacred Edict for Extensive Instruction empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 戊午，岳鍾琪兵至青海，擒阿爾布坦溫布等三虜，收撫逃散部落。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yue Zhongqi's army reached Qinghai, captured the three captives including Alibutan Wenbu, and received the surrender of scattered tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Yue Zhongqi reached Qinghai, seized Alibutan Wenbu and two other captives, and gathered fleeing tribes.

sentences.zh: 詔以青海軍事將竣，策旺阿拉布坦恭順，罷阿爾泰及烏蘭古木兵。

translations.literal: An edict said that because the Qinghai campaign was nearing its end and Tsewang Arabtan was submissive, the armies at Altai and Ulan Gumu were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ended the Altai and Ulan Gumu armies now that Qinghai was nearly pacified and Tsewang Arabtan had submitted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔臨雍大典，改幸學為詣學。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict on the imperial lecture at the National University changed "the Emperor visits the school" to "the Emperor proceeds to the school."
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the court altered the ritual wording for the imperial visit to the National University.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上耕耤田，三推畢，復加一推。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor ploughed the sacred field, finished three furrows, and then added one more.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor ploughed the sacred field three furrows and then one more.

sentences.zh: 甲子，敕州縣舉老農，予頂戴。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, prefectures and districts were ordered to recommend aged farmers and grant them official caps.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, districts were told to honor elderly farmers with official caps.

sentences.zh: 年羹堯奏涼庄道蔣泂剿平阿岡部落，加按察使銜。

translations.literal: Nian Gengyao reported that Liangzhou Circuit intendant Jiang Bing had suppressed the Agang tribes; he was given the rank of surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao reported Jiang Bing's suppression of the Agang tribes and his promotion to surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，高其倬奏中甸番夷就撫。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Gao Qizhuo reported that the Zhongdian tribal peoples had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Gao Qizhuo reported the submission of the Zhongdian tribes.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上祈雨於黑龍潭。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥朔，上詣太學釋奠，御彝倫堂講尚書、大學，廣太學鄉試中額。

translations.literal: Third month, first day of the month on day yihai: the Emperor proceeded to the National University for the sacrifice, lectured on the Documents and Great Learning in the Hall of Moral Principles, and increased the provincial examination quota for the university.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the third month, the Emperor sacrificed at the National University, lectured on the Classics, and enlarged the university provincial quota.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，祭歷代帝王廟。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, sacrifice was offered at the Temple of Former Dynasties' Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the court sacrificed at the Temple of Former Dynasties' Emperors.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor paid his respects at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 岳鍾琪師抵賊巢，羅卜藏丹津遁，獲其母阿爾泰喀屯，青海平。

translations.literal: Yue Zhongqi's army reached the rebels' lair; Lobsang Danjin fled, his mother Altai Katun was captured, and Qinghai was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi reached the rebel stronghold; Lobsang Danjin fled, his mother was taken, and Qinghai was pacified.

sentences.zh: 封年羹堯一等公，岳鍾琪三等公，發帑金二十萬犒軍。

translations.literal: Nian Gengyao was enfeoffed Duke of the First Rank, Yue Zhongqi Duke of the Third Rank, and two hundred thousand taels from the treasury were issued to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao became a first-rank duke, Yue Zhongqi a third-rank duke, and two hundred thousand taels rewarded the troops.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，清明節，上詣景陵行敷土禮。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, at the Qingming festival, the Emperor proceeded to Jing Mausoleum to perform the spreading-earth rite.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, at Qingming, the Emperor went to Jing Mausoleum for the spreading-earth rite.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，以孔毓珣為兩廣總督，李紱為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingwei: Kong Yuxun was made governor-general of the Two Guangs, and Li Fu governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Kong Yuxun became governor-general of the Two Guangs and Li Fu governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，召王大臣訓飭廉親王胤禩，令其改行，並令王大臣察其善惡，據實奏聞。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, princes and high ministers were summoned to admonish Prince Lian Yinsi and order him to reform; they were also ordered to observe his conduct and report truthfully.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, ministers were summoned to admonish Prince Lian Yinsi, order his reform, and report on his conduct.

sentences.zh: 己巳，敦郡王胤蓪有罪，削爵拘禁。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Prince Dun of the Commandery Yin'e was guilty; his title was stripped and he was confined.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Prince Dun Yin'e was stripped of rank and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 閏四月丁丑，續修會典。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day dingchou: the Comprehensive Statutes were continued in revision.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, revision of the Comprehensive Statutes continued.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以嵇曾筠為河道副總督。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Ji Zengyun was made deputy director-general of waterways.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Ji Zengyun became deputy director-general of waterways.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以蘇丹為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Sudan was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Sudan became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸未，青海叛虜阿爾布坦溫布、吹拉克諾木齊、藏巴扎布械繫至京，上御午門受俘。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Qinghai rebels Alibutan Wenbu, Chilak Nuomuqi, and Zangbazhab were sent to the capital in cangues; the Emperor received the captives at the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, three Qinghai rebel leaders were brought to Beijing in cangues and presented at the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯朔，夏至，祭地於方澤，奉聖祖仁皇帝配享。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day of the month on day maoyin: at the summer solstice, Earth was sacrificed to at the Square Mound Altar, with Emperor Shengzu Ren accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the fifth month, at the summer solstice, the Emperor sacrificed to Earth at the Square Mound, with the Kangxi Emperor as associate spirit.

sentences.zh: 貝勒阿布蘭復降為輔國公。

translations.literal: Beile Ablan was again reduced to Defender-general of the State.
translations.idiomatic: Beile Ablan was demoted again to defender-general of the state.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，貝子蘇努坐廉親王黨削爵，並其子俱發右衛。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Beizi Sunu, as a partisan of Prince Lian, was stripped of his title; he and his sons were all sent to the Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Beizi Sunu was stripped of rank for Prince Lian's faction and sent with his sons to the Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔川、陝、湖廣、雲、貴督、撫、提、鎮：「朕聞各處土司，鮮知法紀，苛待屬人，生殺任性。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict to the governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders of Sichuan, Shaanxi, Huguang, Yunnan, and Guizhou said: "We hear that native chiefs everywhere scarcely know law and discipline, cruelly treat their subjects, and kill or spare at will.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, an edict to the southwestern provinces said native chiefs often abused their subjects and killed at will.

sentences.zh: 方今海宇樂利，而土民獨切向隅，朕心不忍。

translations.literal: Now the realm enjoys ease and benefit, yet native peoples alone still feel pressed to the corner; Our heart cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: While the empire prospered, native peoples still suffered; the Emperor said his heart could not bear it.

sentences.zh: 宜嚴飭土司，勿得肆為殘暴，以副朕子惠元元至意。

translations.literal: You should strictly admonish native chiefs not to commit cruelty wantonly, to fulfill Our intent of cherishing all in the primordial unity."
translations.idiomatic: Chiefs were ordered to cease cruelty and honor the Emperor's care for all his subjects."

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，以那敏為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: " On day renxu, Na Min was made Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Na Min became Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，貝子弘春削爵。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Beizi Hongchun was stripped of his title.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Beizi Hongchun lost his rank.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，敕八旗勿擅毆死家人。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiwei: the Eight Banners were forbidden to beat household members to death on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Banners were forbidden to kill household members arbitrarily.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以青海平定，勒石太學。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because Qinghai had been pacified, a stone inscription was ordered at the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, a victory stele was ordered at the Imperial University for the Qinghai pacification.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上以闕里廟災，致祭先師，遣官監修。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, because the temple at Confucius's birthplace had suffered fire, the Emperor offered sacrifice to the Sage and sent officials to supervise repairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, after fire at Qufu, the Emperor sacrificed to Confucius and ordered repairs.

sentences.zh: 降貝子胤祹為鎮國公。

translations.literal: Beizi Yintao was reduced to Defender-general of the State.
translations.idiomatic: Beizi Yintao was demoted to defender-general of the state.

sentences.zh: 李光復罷，以李永紹為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Li Guangfu was dismissed; Li Yongshao was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangfu left office and Li Yongshao became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，御制朋黨論，頒示諸臣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingsi: the Emperor composed the Treatise on Factions and issued it to the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Emperor issued his Treatise on Factions to the court.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以丁壽為阿爾泰駐防將軍。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Ding Shou was made garrison general at Altai.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Ding Shou became garrison general at Altai.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，副將軍阿喇衲卒于軍，上念其久勞於外，加予世職。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Deputy Commander Arana died in camp; because he had long toiled abroad, a hereditary office was granted in addition.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Deputy Commander Arana died on campaign and received a posthumous hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，命鄉、會試迴避士子一體考試，別派大臣閱取。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: provincial and metropolitan candidates subject to avoidance were ordered to be examined together with other candidates, with separate ministers appointed to read the papers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, examination avoidance rules were revised so related candidates were tested with others under separate examiners.

sentences.zh: 壬午，停本年秋決。

translations.literal: On day renwu, this year's autumn judicial review was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, autumn executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以田文鏡署河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Tian Wenjing was made acting governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Tian Wenjing became acting Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑朔，以阿爾泰軍功予丁壽世職。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day of the month on day xinchou: because of Altai military merit, Ding Shou was granted a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the ninth month, Ding Shou received a hereditary office for Altai service.

sentences.zh: 停戶部捐納事例。

translations.literal: Purchase-by-donation regulations at the Ministry of Revenue were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue purchase-by-donation was halted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命山西丁銀攤入地糧徵收，其後各省以漸行之。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, an order was issued that Shanxi poll tax silver be assessed within land grain; afterward the other provinces gradually followed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Shanxi poll tax was folded into land tax, a practice other provinces later adopted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，賜陳惪華等二百九十九人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yihai: Chen Dun and two hundred ninety-nine others were granted metropolitan graduate degrees with distinctions in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Chen Dun and 299 others received metropolitan degrees with distinctions.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，封明裔朱之璉為一等侯，世奉明祀。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Ming descendant Zhu Zhilian was enfeoffed Marquis of the First Rank, charged generation after generation to maintain Ming sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Zhu Zhilian, heir of the Ming, became a first-rank marquis to maintain Ming rites.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔京師建忠義祠。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, an edict ordered a Hall of Loyalty and Righteousness built in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the court ordered a Hall of Loyalty and Righteousness in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔厄魯特郡王額駙阿寶賜往青海游牧。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, an edict granted Olot prince and imperial son-in-law Abao pasture in Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Prince Abao of the Olot was granted Qinghai pasture.

sentences.zh: 設寧夏駐防。

translations.literal: A Ningxia garrison was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Ningxia garrison was set up.

sentences.zh: 丙申，刑部尚書阿爾松阿以無心效力，奪職削爵，發往盛京，以其伯音德襲果毅公。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Minister of Justice Ersong'a, for lack of wholehearted service, was stripped of office and title and sent to Mukden; his uncle Yinde inherited the office of Duke Guoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Minister of Justice Ersong'a was dismissed and sent to Mukden; his uncle Yinde inherited Duke Guoyi.

sentences.zh: 暹羅國貢稻種果樹。

translations.literal: Siam sent tribute of rice seed and fruit trees.
translations.idiomatic: Siam presented rice seed and fruit trees as tribute.

sentences.zh: 設直隸布政司、按察司，以巡撫李維鈞為總督。

translations.literal: The Zhili provincial administration commission and surveillance commission were established; Governor Li Weijun was made governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili gained provincial administration and surveillance offices, and Li Weijun became governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以音德、誇岱俱為領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yinde and Kuadai were both made senior chamberlains of the imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yinde and Kuadai became senior chamberlains of the imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以蘇丹為寧夏將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Sudan was made Ningxia regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Sudan became Ningxia regional commander.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，弘晟有罪削爵。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu: Hongsheng was guilty and stripped of his title.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Hongsheng lost his rank for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以綽奇為蒙古都統，噶爾弼為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Chuoqi was made Mongol commander-in-chief and Ga'erbi Han Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Chuoqi became Mongol commander-in-chief and Ga'erbi Han commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，高其倬奏官兵進剿仲苗，平之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Gao Qizhuo reported that officers and soldiers had advanced against the Zhong Miao and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Gao Qizhuo reported the pacification of the Zhong Miao.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，定稱孝庄文皇后山陵為昭西陵。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the mausoleum of Empress Xiaozhuang Wen was fixed to be called Zhaoxi Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Empress Xiaozhuang Wen's tomb was named Zhaoxi Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，命太學立進士題名碑。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: the Imperial University was ordered to erect a metropolitan graduate name stele.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the National University was ordered to set up a graduate name stele.

sentences.zh: 癸未，廢太子胤礽薨，封理親王，諡曰密。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the deposed Crown Prince Yinreng died; he was enfeoffed Prince Li and given the posthumous title Mi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the deposed Crown Prince Yinreng died and was posthumously made Prince Li with the name Mi.

sentences.zh: 以綽奇為奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Chuoqi was made Fengtian regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Chuoqi became Fengtian regional commander.

sentences.zh: 己丑，裕親王保泰有罪削爵，以其弟子廣寧襲封裕親王。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Prince Yu Baotai was guilty and stripped of his title; his younger brother's son Guangning succeeded as Prince Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Prince Yu Baotai lost his rank; his nephew Guangning inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 設湖南學政。

translations.literal: A Hunan provincial education intendant was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Hunan education intendant was appointed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the seasonal great offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the collective ancestral sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江南、浙江等省五十七州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for fifty-seven prefectures, districts, and guards in Jiangnan, Zhejiang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas across fifty-seven districts in Jiangnan, Zhejiang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Annam, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Annam, and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年乙巳春正月癸丑，詔以固安官地二百頃為井田，遣八旗閒散受耕。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day guichou: an edict set aside two hundred qing of Gu'an official land as well-field land and sent idle Banner households to cultivate it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the first day of spring, an edict turned two hundred qing of Gu'an official land into well-fields for idle Banner households.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以蔡珽為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Cai Ting was made Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Cai Ting became Censor-in-chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以阿齊圖為步軍統領。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Aqitu was made infantry commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Aqitu became infantry commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，日月合璧，五星聯珠。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu: the sun and moon appeared united and the five planets aligned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the sun and moon appeared conjoined and the five planets aligned.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上以三年服闋，行祫祭禮。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, because the three-year mourning period had ended, the Emperor performed the collective ancestral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, with mourning ended, the Emperor performed the collective ancestral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔責年羹堯未能撫恤青海殘部，倘有一二人逃入準噶爾者，必重罪之。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, an edict rebuked Nian Gengyao for failing to soothe and comfort the remnant tribes of Qinghai, saying that if even one or two persons fled into the Dzungars, he would be heavily punished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, an edict warned Nian Gengyao to pacify Qinghai remnants or face severe punishment should any flee to the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 乙未，鄂倫岱坐廉親王黨奪職削爵，發往盛京，以其弟誇岱襲一等公。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Erendai, as a partisan of Prince Lian, was stripped of office and title and sent to Mukden; his younger brother Kuadai inherited the rank of Duke of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Erendai was dismissed for Prince Lian's faction and sent to Mukden; his brother Kuadai inherited a first-rank dukedom.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，召廷臣宣示胤禟罪狀，並及胤禩、胤蓪、胤禵。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, court ministers were summoned and the crimes of Yintang were proclaimed, together with those of Yinsi, Yin'e, and Yinti.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, ministers heard Yintang's crimes proclaimed along with those of Yinsi, Yin'e, and Yinti.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，以馬會伯為貴州提督。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingwei: Ma Huibo was made provincial commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Ma Huibo became Guizhou provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 策旺阿拉布坦遣使入貢。

translations.literal: Tsewang Arabtan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang Arabtan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 設安徽學政。

translations.literal: An Anhui provincial education intendant was established.
translations.idiomatic: An Anhui education intendant was appointed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大學士張鵬翮卒。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Grand Secretary Zhang Penghe died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Grand Secretary Zhang Penghe died.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書張伯行卒。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Zhang Boxing died.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Zhang Boxing died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，蠲蘇、鬆浮糧四十五萬兩。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the floating grain tax of Suzhou and Songjiang totaling four hundred fifty thousand taels was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, four hundred fifty thousand taels of floating grain tax in Suzhou and Songjiang were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 滿保奏臺灣生番七十四社歸化。

translations.literal: Manbao memorialized that seventy-four communities of Taiwan raw tribes had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Manbao reported that seventy-four Taiwan aboriginal communities had submitted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，年羹堯表賀日月合璧，五星聯珠，將「朝乾夕惕」寫作「夕惕朝乾」。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Nian Gengyao memorialized congratulating the conjunction of sun and moon and the alignment of five planets, writing "diligent morning and evening" as "evening vigilance, morning diligence."
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Nian Gengyao congratulated a celestial omen but reversed the phrase "diligent morning and evening" to "evening vigilance, morning diligence."

sentences.zh: 詔切責之曰：「年羹堯非粗心者，是直不以朝乾夕惕許朕耳。

translations.literal: An edict sharply rebuked him, saying: "Nian Gengyao is not a careless man; he plainly will not grant Us the phrase 'diligent morning and evening.'"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked him: Nian Gengyao was not careless but refused to grant him the expected phrase of diligence.

sentences.zh: 則年羹堯青海之功，亦在朕許與不許之間，未可知也。

translations.literal: Then whether Nian Gengyao's Qinghai merit stands between Our granting and not granting remains unknown.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said Nian Gengyao's Qinghai achievements might no longer be recognized.

sentences.zh: 顯系不敬，其明白回奏。

translations.literal: This is clearly disrespect; let him answer plainly in a memorial."
translations.idiomatic: He called the lapse clearly disrespectful and ordered a plain reply."

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，敘總理王大臣、怡親王胤祥予一子郡王，隆科多、馬齊加予世職。

translations.literal: " On day yichou, rewards were recorded for the chief prince-regent Prince Yi Yinxiang—one son made commandery prince; Longkodo and Ma Qi were granted hereditary offices.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Prince Yi Yinxiang received a commandery prince for a son; Longkodo and Ma Qi gained hereditary offices.

sentences.zh: 廉親王胤禩不與，並嚴詔訓責之。

translations.literal: Prince Lian Yinqi was excluded and also sternly rebuked by edict.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Lian Yinqi was left out and sternly rebuked by edict.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，調年羹堯為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jimao: Nian Gengyao was transferred to be general at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Nian Gengyao was made general at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以岳鍾琪為川陝總督。

translations.literal: Yue Zhongqi was made governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi became governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 遣學士眾佛保、副都統查史往準噶爾定界。

translations.literal: Academician Zhongfubao and Vice Commander-in-chief Cha Shi were dispatched to the Zungars to fix the border.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongfubao and Cha Shi were sent to the Zungars to delimit the frontier.

sentences.zh: 以董吉那為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: Dongjina was made general at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Dongjina became general at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以田從典為大學士。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Tian Congdian was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Tian Congdian became Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，以左都御史尹泰為盛京禮部侍郎，兼理奉天府尹。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai: Left Censor-in-chief Yin Tai was made Vice Minister of Rites at Mukden, concurrently administering the Fengtian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Yin Tai became Mukden Vice Minister of Rites and Fengtian prefect.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，詔年羹堯之子年富、年興，隆科多之子玉柱俱褫職。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: an edict stripped Nian Gengyao's sons Nian Fu and Nian Xing, and Longkodo's son Yuzhu, of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Nian Fu, Nian Xing, and Yuzhu were all dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命上三旗世職及登城巴圖魯之子，二十以下，十四以上，揀選引見錄用。

translations.literal: On day yihai, sons of hereditary offices in the Upper Three Banners and of "storm-the-wall" champions, aged fourteen to under twenty, were selected for audience and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, banner sons aged fourteen to nineteen were selected for appointment.

sentences.zh: 削年羹堯太保，尋褫其一等公。

translations.literal: Nian Gengyao was stripped of Grand Tutor rank; soon afterward his rank as duke of the first class was also removed.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao lost Grand Tutor rank and soon his first-class dukedom.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，削隆科多太保。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingwei: Longkodo was stripped of Grand Tutor rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Longkodo lost Grand Tutor rank.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大學士白潢罷，以高其位為大學士，張廷玉署大學士。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Grand Secretary Bai Huang was dismissed; Gao Qiwei was made Grand Secretary and Zhang Tingyu acting Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Bai Huang was dismissed; Gao Qiwei and Zhang Tingyu received Grand Secretary posts.

sentences.zh: 命隆科多往阿蘭善山修城。

translations.literal: Longkodo was ordered to go to Alashan Mountain to repair the wall.
translations.idiomatic: Longkodo was sent to repair the wall at Alashan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，杭州將軍年羹堯黜為閒散旗員。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Hangzhou general Nian Gengyao was reduced to a supernumerary bannerman.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Nian Gengyao was demoted to a supernumerary bannerman.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，貝子胤禟有罪削爵。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Prince Yintang was guilty and his title was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Prince Yintang was stripped of his title for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，李維鈞以黨年羹堯逮鞫，以李紱為直隸總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinwei: Li Weijun was arrested and tried for siding with Nian Gengyao; Li Fu was made governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Li Weijun was tried for the Nian faction; Li Fu became Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上駐圓明園。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor took up residence at the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor stayed at the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 加怡親王胤祥俸，果郡王胤禮護衛。

translations.literal: Prince Yi Yinxiang's salary was increased, and Prince Guo Yinzhi received an enlarged guard.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi Yinxiang received a salary increase; Prince Guo Yinzhi received more guards.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，以朱軾為大學士，改蔡珽為吏部尚書，仍管兵部、都察院事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiayin: Zhu Shi was made Grand Secretary; Cai Bing was changed to Minister of Personnel while still overseeing the Ministry of War and the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Zhu Shi became Grand Secretary; Cai Bing became Minister of Personnel with war and censorate duties.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，逮繫年羹堯下刑部。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Nian Gengyao was arrested and sent to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Nian Gengyao was arrested and handed to the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，命巡撫不與總督同城者，參劾屬員，自行審結。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: where a provincial governor did not share a city with the governor-general, he was empowered to impeach subordinates and decide cases himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, governors not resident with governors-general were given independent impeachment and trial powers.

sentences.zh: 丙子，封恆親王胤祺子弘晊輔國公。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Hongzhi, son of Prince Heng Yinqi, was enfeoffed as Defender of the State.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Prince Heng's son Hongzhi was made Defender of the State.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以楊名時為雲貴總督，管巡撫事，鄂爾泰為雲南巡撫，管總督事。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Yang Mingshi was made governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou with charge of the governorship; Ortai was made governor of Yunnan with charge of the governor-generalship.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Yang Mingshi and Ortai exchanged Yunnan-Guizhou governor and governor-general duties.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，上謁陵。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengzi: the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Emperor visited the tombs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，還宮。

translations.literal: On day wushen, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以噶爾弼為奉天將軍。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Ga'erbi was made general at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Ga'erbi became general at Mukden.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，降郡王胤禵為貝子。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingmao: Prince of the Commandery Yinti was reduced to beile.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the fourteenth prince Yinti was demoted from commandery prince to beile.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，廷臣議上年羹堯罪九十二款。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, court ministers deliberated on Nian Gengyao's ninety-two counts of crime.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, ministers reviewed ninety-two charges against Nian Gengyao.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「年羹堯賜死，其子年富立斬，餘子充軍，免其父兄緣坐。

translations.literal: The imperial rescript read: "Nian Gengyao is granted death; his son Nian Fu is to be beheaded at once; the remaining sons are sent to military exile; his father and elder brothers are exempted from guilt by association.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao was ordered to die; Nian Fu was beheaded at once; other sons were exiled; kin were spared association guilt.

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，汪景祺以謗訕處斬。

translations.literal: " On day xinsi, Wang Jingqi was executed for slander.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingqi was executed for slander on xinsi day."

sentences.zh: 癸未，以覺羅巴延德為天津水師營都統。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Aisin Gioro Bayande was made commander of the Tianjin naval camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Bayande became commander of the Tianjin naval camp.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the seasonal offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the court performed the seasonal temple offering.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江蘇、河南、浙江、廣東等省二十七州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for twenty-seven prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangsu, Henan, Zhejiang, Guangdong, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in twenty-seven districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、西洋國入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Western countries sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Western states paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年丙午春正月甲午，上御太和殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day jiawu: the Emperor took the throne in the Hall of Supreme Harmony to receive congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the first month, the Emperor received New Year congratulations at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 朝正外籓，依先朝例，賚予銀幣。

translations.literal: Foreign princes attending the New Year audience were rewarded with silver and coins according to former-court precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Visiting foreign princes received silver and coins by precedent.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宣詔罪狀皇九弟胤禟。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, an edict proclaimed the crimes of the ninth imperial brother Yintang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the court proclaimed Prince Yintang's crimes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，集廷臣宣詔罪狀皇八弟胤禩，易親王為民王，褫黃帶，絕屬籍，革其婦烏雅氏福晉，逐回母家，復革民王，拘禁宗人府，敕令易名名曰阿其那，名其子弘旺曰菩薩保。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, ministers were assembled and an edict proclaimed the crimes of the eighth imperial brother Yinqi: his princedom was changed to "commoner prince"; the yellow belt was removed and he was struck from the clan register; his consort of the Uya clan was removed as princess consort and sent back to her mother's house; the commoner princedom was again removed; he was confined in the Imperial Clan Court; he was ordered renamed Aqina, and his son Hongwang was named Pusabao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Yinqi was degraded, stripped of rank and consort, confined, and renamed Aqina; his son was renamed Pusabao.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，削隆科多職，仍令赴鄂羅斯議界。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Longkodo was removed from office but still ordered to go to Russia to negotiate the border.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Longkodo lost office but was still sent to negotiate the Russian border.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，贈故尚書顧八代太傅，諡文端，上之授讀師也。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the late Minister Gu Badai was posthumously made Grand Tutor with the posthumous title Wenduan—he had been the Emperor's tutor in reading.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor's former tutor Gu Badai was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，以孫柱為吏部尚書，兼管兵部。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi: Sun Zhu was made Minister of Personnel, concurrently overseeing the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Sun Zhu became Minister of Personnel with war duties.

sentences.zh: 以法海為兵部尚書，福敏為左都御史。

translations.literal: Fahai was made Minister of War and Fumin Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Fahai became Minister of War; Fumin became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 貝子魯賓、鎮國公永謙俱以議胤禩獄依違削爵，尋起魯賓為輔國公。

translations.literal: Princes Lubin and Defender of the State Yongqian were both stripped of rank for equivocating in the Yinqi case; soon Lubin was restored as Defender of the State.
translations.idiomatic: Lubin and Yongqian lost rank for hedging in Yinqi's trial; Lubin was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 大學士朱軾有母喪，賜白金四千庀葬事。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Zhu Shi was in mourning for his mother; four thousand taels of silver were granted to arrange the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shi mourned his mother and received four thousand taels for the funeral.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，簡親王雅爾江阿削爵，以其弟神保住襲封。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Prince Jian Yarjiang'a was stripped of rank; his younger brother Shenbaozhu succeeded to the title.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Prince Jian Yarjiang'a was demoted; Shenbaozhu inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以張廷玉為大學士，蔣廷錫為戶部尚書，以申穆德為右衛將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Zhang Tingyu was made Grand Secretary, Jiang Tingxi Minister of Revenue, and Shen Mude general of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Zhang Tingyu, Jiang Tingxi, and Shen Mude received new posts.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，命丁壽屯兵特斯，備策旺阿拉布坦。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: Ding Shou was ordered to station troops at Tes to guard against Tsewang Arabtan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Ding Shou was posted at Tes against Tsewang Arabtan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，侍講錢名世投詩年羹堯事發，革去職銜，上親書「名教罪人」四字懸其門，並令文臣作為文詩刺惡之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the exposé case of Lecturer Qian Mingshi presenting poems to Nian Gengyao came to light; his title was removed; the Emperor personally wrote the four characters "enemy of moral teaching" and hung them at his gate, and ordered civil officials to compose essays and poems denouncing him.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Qian Mingshi lost rank for flattering Nian Gengyao in verse; the Emperor labeled him an enemy of moral teaching.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，以范時繹為兩江總督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jimao: Fan Shiyi was made governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Fan Shiyi became governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，禁錮皇十四弟胤禵及其子白起於壽皇殿側，以子白敦為鎮國公。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guisi: the fourteenth imperial brother Yinti and his son Baiqi were confined beside the Hall of Imperial Longevity; his son Baidun was made Defender of the State.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Yinti and Baiqi were confined; Baidun was made Defender of the State.

sentences.zh: 誅鄂倫岱、阿爾松阿於戍所。

translations.literal: Erlendai and Aersong'a were executed at their places of banishment.
translations.idiomatic: Erlendai and Aersong'a were put to death in exile.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，改胤禟名為塞思黑，拘於保定。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Yintang was renamed Sesheihei and detained at Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Yintang was renamed Sesheihei and held at Baoding.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命順承郡王錫保食親王俸。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Prince Shuncheng Xibao was ordered to receive a prince's stipend.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Prince Shuncheng Xibao was granted a prince's salary.

sentences.zh: 封皇十五弟胤烜為貝勒，皇二十弟胤禕為貝子。

translations.literal: The fifteenth imperial brother Yinzhuan was enfeoffed as beile, and the twentieth imperial brother Yinqi as beizi.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth and twentieth imperial brothers received beile and beizi ranks.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，以輔國公巴賽為振武將軍，備邊。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai: Defender of the State Basai was made General Who Quells Martial Ardor to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Basai was made frontier general.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以查弼納為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Zhabina was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Zhabina became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，釋回軍前御史陶彝等十三人。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: the thirteen censors Tao Yi and others at the front were released and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, thirteen front-line censors including Tao Yi were released.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命蔡珽專管都統。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Cai Bing was ordered to oversee the commandery prince regiments exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Cai Bing was put in sole charge of the commandery prince banners.

sentences.zh: 以查弼納、楊名時為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Zhabina and Yang Mingshi were made Ministers of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Zhabina and Yang Mingshi became Ministers of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 平郡王納爾素有罪削爵，以其子福彭襲封。

translations.literal: Prince Ping Narsu was guilty and stripped of rank; his son Fupeng succeeded to the title.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ping Narsu lost his title; his son Fupeng inherited it.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，停本年秋決。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingyin: autumn executions were suspended for this year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, autumn executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，李紱奏塞思黑卒於保定。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Li Fu memorialized that Sesheihei had died at Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Li Fu reported Sesheihei's death at Baoding.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，以宜兆熊為湖廣總督，尋命福敏代之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renchen: Yizhaoxiong was made governor-general of Huguang; soon Fumin was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Yizhaoxiong became Huguang governor-general; Fumin soon replaced him.

sentences.zh: 以蔡良為福州將軍。

translations.literal: Cai Liang was made general at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Liang became general at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 貝子滿都護降為輔國公，撤出佐領。

translations.literal: Prince Manzhuhu was reduced to Defender of the State and removed from his company captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Manzhuhu was demoted and stripped of his company captaincy.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，輔國公阿布蘭以違例謝恩削爵，撤出佐領。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Defender of the State Ablan was stripped of rank for irregular thanksgiving audience and removed from his company captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Ablan lost rank for improper audience thanks and lost his captaincy.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，重九節，上御乾清宮，賜宴廷臣，賦柏梁體詩。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Double Ninth: the Emperor presided in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, bestowing a banquet on court ministers and composing a linked-verse poem in the Bolang style.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Double Ninth, the Emperor feasted ministers and composed linked verse.

sentences.zh: 己亥，錫保奏阿其那卒于禁所。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Xibao memorialized that Aqina had died in confinement.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Xibao reported Aqina's death in custody.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，起復大學士朱軾在內閣行走。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Grand Secretary Zhu Shi was recalled to duty and walked in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Zhu Shi returned from mourning to the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，侍郎查嗣庭以謗訕下獄。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Vice Minister Cha Siting was imprisoned for slander.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Cha Siting was jailed for slander.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，設浙江觀風整俗使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiazi: the Zhejiang commissioner for observing customs and reforming morals was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zhejiang gained a commissioner to observe customs and reform morals.

sentences.zh: 命鄉試五經取中之副榜及兩次取中副榜，准作舉人。

translations.literal: It was ordered that provincial examination graduates who passed on the Five Classics via the supplementary list, and those who passed the supplementary list twice, be recognized as licentiates.
translations.idiomatic: Supplementary-list Five Classics passers and double supplementary passers were recognized as licentiates.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔廷臣：「皇考臨御六十餘年，躬節行儉。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, an edict told court ministers: "Our late father ruled for more than sixty years, personally practicing moderation and thrift.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor told ministers how Kangxi had ruled frugally for sixty years.

sentences.zh: 宮廷地毯用至三四十年，猶然整潔。

translations.literal: Palace carpets were used thirty or forty years and were still neat.
translations.idiomatic: Palace carpets lasted decades and remained intact.

sentences.zh: 服御之物，一惟質樸，絕少珍奇。

translations.literal: Garments and equipage were all plain quality, with very few rarities.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial goods were plain, with few luxuries.

sentences.zh: 昨檢點舊器，及取迴避暑山莊陳設，思慕盛德，實無終已。

translations.literal: Yesterday, inspecting old furnishings and bringing back items from the Mountain Estate for Summer Retreat, Our longing for his great virtue truly has no end.
translations.idiomatic: Inspecting old furnishings from the summer retreat, the Emperor said his longing for Kangxi was endless.

sentences.zh: 用特書此，以詔我子孫。

translations.literal: We therefore write this expressly to instruct Our sons and descendants."
translations.idiomatic: He wrote this to instruct his descendants."

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，裕親王廣寧削爵，永錮宗人府。

translations.literal: " On day xinsi, Prince Yu Guangning was stripped of rank and permanently confined in the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yu Guangning lost rank and was permanently confined on xinsi day."

sentences.zh: 甲申，以普雄苗地，界連川、滇，命川陝總督移駐成都。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, because the Puxiong Miao territory bordered Sichuan and Yunnan, the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general was ordered to move his headquarters to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general was ordered to Chengdu for the Puxiong Miao frontier.

sentences.zh: 以鄂爾泰為雲貴總督，憲德為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Ortai was made governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, and Xiande governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Xiande became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，琉球國謝賜匾額，貢方物。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Ryukyu thanked the court for a bestowed plaque and presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Ryukyu thanked the court for a plaque and sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，大學士高其位罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: Grand Secretary Gao Qiwei was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Grand Secretary Gao Qiwei was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，敘富寧安久戍功，封一等侯。

translations.literal: On day renzi, long service on the Funing garrison was rewarded with enfeoffment as marquis of the first class.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Funing garrison service was rewarded with a first-class marquisate.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔浙江士習敝壞，工為懷挾，停其鄉會試。

translations.literal: On day yimao, an edict said Zhejiang scholarly habits were corrupt and skilled at smuggling crib notes; its provincial and metropolitan examinations were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Zhejiang examinations were suspended for corrupt scholarly habits and cheating.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，王大臣請將阿其那、塞思黑妻子正法。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengshen: princes and ministers asked that the wives and children of Aqina and Sesheihei be executed according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, ministers sought execution of Aqina and Sesheihei's families.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「阿其那、塞思黑雖大逆不道，而反叛事迹未彰，免其緣坐。

translations.literal: The imperial instruction said: "Although Aqina and Sesheihei committed great treason, their acts of rebellion were not yet manifest; guilt by association is waived.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ruled that although Aqina and Sesheihei were traitors, kin were spared because rebellion was not fully proven.

sentences.zh: 塞思黑之妻逐回母家禁錮。

translations.literal: Sesheihei's wife is sent back to her mother's house and confined.
translations.idiomatic: Sesheihei's wife was sent to her mother's house under confinement.

sentences.zh: 其餘眷屬，交內務府養贍。

translations.literal: The remaining dependents are handed to the Imperial Household Department for maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: Other dependents were placed under the Imperial Household Department for support.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，命河南、陝西、四川均攤丁銀入地並徵。

translations.literal: " On day xinyou, an order was issued that Henan, Shaanxi, and Sichuan should apportion the poll-tax silver into the land tax and collect them together.
translations.idiomatic: Poll-tax silver was merged into land tax collection in Henan, Shaanxi, and Sichuan."

sentences.zh: 乙丑，御史謝濟世疏劾田文鏡十罪，詔褫職遣戍。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Censor Xie Jishi memorialized impeaching Tian Wenjing on ten counts; an edict stripped him of office and sent him to exile.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Xie Jishi impeached Tian Wenjing on ten counts; Tian was dismissed and exiled.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鄂爾泰奏剿辦仲苗就撫者二十一寨，查出熟地荒地三萬餘畝。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Ortai memorialized that twenty-one stockades of Zhong Miao who had submitted after suppression were pacified, and more than thirty thousand mu of cultivated and waste land were identified.
