translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Ortai reported twenty-one pacified Zhong Miao stockades and over thirty thousand mu of land surveyed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以李紱為工部右侍郎，以宜兆熊為直隸總督，劉師恕協辦，以毛文銓為京口將軍。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Li Fu was made Right Vice Minister of Works; Yizhaoxiong was made governor-general of Zhili with Liu Shishu as assistant; Mao Wenquan was made general at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Li Fu, Yizhaoxiong, Liu Shishu, and Mao Wenquan received new appointments.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the seasonal offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the court performed the seasonal temple offering.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、山東、安徽、江西、湖廣等省六十三州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for sixty-three prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Shandong, Anhui, Jiangxi, Huguang, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in sixty-three districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、蘇祿入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Sulu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Sulu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年丁未春正月戊子朔，時享太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, new moon on day wuzi: the seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the new moon of the first month of spring, the seasonal sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，赦年羹堯之子之戍邊者。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the sons of Nian Gengyao who had been banished to the frontier were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Nian Gengyao's sons in frontier exile were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，王大臣奏黃河清，請朝賀，上不許。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, princes and ministers memorialized that the Yellow River had cleared and asked for a court celebration; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, ministers reported the Yellow River had cleared and sought a celebration; the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 加文武官一級。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials received one rank of promotion.

sentences.zh: 敕八旗交納銅器，三年限滿，隱匿者罪之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Eight Banners to turn in copper vessels, with a three-year deadline; those who concealed them were punished.
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Banners were ordered to surrender copper vessels within three years; concealment was punishable.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以孫柱署大學士。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Sun Zhu was appointed acting Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Sun Zhu became acting Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以沈近思為左都御史兼吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Shen Jinshi was made Left Censor-in-chief and concurrent Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Shen Jinshi became Left Censor-in-chief and Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，上謁陵。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingmao: the Emperor paid respects at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingmao day, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，廣州駐防兵丁滋事，將軍李杕以徇庇論死。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, garrison soldiers at Guangzhou caused trouble; General Li Di was sentenced to death for shielding them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Guangzhou garrison troops rioted; General Li Di was sentenced to death for covering them up.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命李紱往廣西擒捕逸犯羅文綱。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Li Fu was ordered to Guangxi to capture the fugitive Luo Wengang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Li Fu was sent to Guangxi to seize the fugitive Luo Wengang.

sentences.zh: 文綱自投來歸。

translations.literal: Wengang came forward and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Wengang surrendered of his own accord.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，敕本年會試於三月舉行，給與薑湯木炭。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: an edict ordered the metropolitan examination held in the third month and ginger soup and charcoal provided.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin day, the metropolitan examination was set for the third month with ginger soup and charcoal supplied.

sentences.zh: 以廣祿襲裕親王。

translations.literal: Guanglu succeeded as Prince Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Guanglu inherited the title Prince Yu.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上宣示蔡珽罪狀，下刑部拘訊。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor proclaimed Cai Ting's crimes and handed him to the Ministry of Punishments for detention and interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor announced Cai Ting's crimes and ordered the Ministry of Punishments to detain and try him.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，開閩省洋禁。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the maritime ban in Fujian was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Fujian's maritime trade ban was opened.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鄂羅斯察罕汗遣使臣薩瓦表賀登極，進貢方物，賞賚如例。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Russian Tsar Khan sent the envoy Sawa to congratulate the accession and present tribute; rewards were granted as usual.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Russia's Tsar Khan sent envoy Sawa to congratulate the enthronement and offer tribute; rewards followed precedent.

sentences.zh: 內大臣馬武卒。

translations.literal: Inner Minister Ma Wu died.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Minister Ma Wu died.

sentences.zh: 大學士高其位卒。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Gao Qiwei died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Gao Qiwei died.

sentences.zh: 閏三月乙丑，揀選下第舉人，分發直省，以州縣用。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day yichou: failed metropolitan candidates were selected and dispatched to provinces for appointment as prefectural and county officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month, failed metropolitan candidates were assigned to provinces as prefectural and county officials.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以宜兆熊為吏部尚書，邁柱為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Yi Zhaoxiong was made Minister of Personnel and Mai Zhu governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Yi Zhaoxiong became Minister of Personnel and Mai Zhu Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，烏蒙、鎮雄兩土府改設流官。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the two native prefectures of Wumeng and Zhenxiong were converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Wumeng and Zhenxiong native prefectures were replaced with regular officials.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以覺羅伊禮布為奉天將軍，常壽為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Aisin Gioro Yilibu was made general at Fengtian and Changshou general at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Yilibu became Fengtian general and Changshou Jiangning general.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，弘升有罪削爵。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Hongsheng was stripped of his rank for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Hongsheng lost his title for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，吐魯番回酋請進貢，不許，為已撤兵，又以其地許策旺阿拉布坦也。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: the Turfan Muslim chief asked to send tribute; this was refused, as troops had been withdrawn and the territory had been promised to Tsewang Araptan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Turfan's Muslim chief sought to send tribute but was refused because troops had withdrawn and the land was promised to Tsewang Araptan.

sentences.zh: 以福敏為吏部尚書，黃國材署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Fu Min was made Minister of Personnel; Huang Guocai acting Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Min became Minister of Personnel; Huang Guocai acted as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賜彭啟豐等二百二十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Peng Qifeng and two hundred twenty-six others were granted jinshi degrees and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Peng Qifeng and 226 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命州縣會學官舉優行生。

translations.literal: On day guisi, prefectures and counties were ordered, together with school officials, to nominate students of excellent conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, local officials were ordered to recommend students of outstanding conduct.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，設宗室御史二員。

translations.literal: On day yisi, two Imperial Clan censors were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, two censor posts for the Imperial Clan were created.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，以拉錫為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuwu: Laxi was made Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuwu day, Laxi became Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 查嗣庭死於獄，戮其屍。

translations.literal: Zha Siting died in prison; his corpse was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zha Siting died in prison and his body was posthumously executed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，敘烏蒙、鎮雄功，予鄂爾泰世職。

translations.literal: On day yihai, merit in Wumeng and Zhenxiong was recorded; Ortai was granted a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, service in Wumeng and Zhenxiong was rewarded with a hereditary post for Ortai.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，移盛京副都統一員駐錦州，設熊岳副都統。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengzi: one deputy commander at Mukden was moved to garrison Jinzhou; a deputy commander at Xiongyue was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, a Mukden deputy commander was stationed at Jinzhou and a new deputy commander was set at Xiongyue.

sentences.zh: 封誠親王胤祉子弘景為鎮國公。

translations.literal: Prince Cheng's son Hongjing was enfeoffed as Duke of the State.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Cheng's son Hongjing was made a state duke.

sentences.zh: 隆科多以罪削爵，以其弟慶復襲一等公。

translations.literal: Longkodo was stripped of rank for his crimes; his brother Qingfu succeeded as first-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: Longkodo lost his title for crimes; his brother Qingfu inherited the first-class dukedom.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，以富寧安為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yimao: Funing'an was made Han Army commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Funing'an became Han Army commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己未，李永紹罷，以黃國材為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Li Yongshao left office; Huang Guocai was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Li Yongshao was dismissed and Huang Guocai became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 加田文鏡尚書，為河南總督。

translations.literal: Tian Wenjing was promoted to ministerial rank and made governor-general of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Wenjing was raised to minister and made Henan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以誇岱為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Kuodai was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Kuodai became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丙子，晉封輔國公弘晊、鄂齊、熙良為鎮國公。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Junior State Dukes Hongzhi, Eqi, and Xiliang were promoted to State Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Hongzhi, Eqi, and Xiliang were promoted from junior state duke to state duke.

sentences.zh: 已革貝勒蘇努塗抹聖祖硃諭，經王、大臣、刑部參奏。

translations.literal: The stripped beile Sunu had defaced vermilion rescripts of the Kangxi Emperor; princes, ministers, and the Ministry of Punishments memorialized against him.
translations.idiomatic: Stripped beile Sunu had defaced Kangxi's vermilion rescripts; princes, ministers, and the Ministry of Punishments impeached him.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「蘇努怙惡不悛，竟令其子蘇爾金、庫爾陳、烏爾陳信從西洋之教。

translations.literal: A rescript was received: "Sunu, persisting in wickedness without reform, actually allowed his sons Surjin, Kuer Chen, and Wuer Chen to follow the Western religion.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ruled: "Sunu refused to reform and let his sons Surjin, Kuer Chen, and Wuer Chen adopt Christianity.

sentences.zh: 諭令悛改，伊竟抗稱：『原甘正法，不能改教。

translations.literal: When ordered to repent, he defiantly declared: 'I would rather accept legal punishment than change religion.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to repent, he defied: 'I would rather die by law than abandon the faith.

sentences.zh: 』今又查出昔年聖祖硃批奏摺，敢於狂書塗抹，見者髮指。

translations.literal: Now vermilion-marked memorials of former years have been found, which he dared to scribble over wantonly, making those who see them bristle with anger.
translations.idiomatic: Vermilion-marked memorials from Kangxi's time were found defaced, enraging all who saw them.

sentences.zh: 即應照大逆律概行正法。

translations.literal: By the law on great treason he should at once be executed in full.
translations.idiomatic: By the law on great treason he deserved immediate execution.

sentences.zh: 但伊子孫多至四十人，悉行正法，則有所不忍。

translations.literal: Yet he has as many as forty descendants; to execute them all would be more than one could bear.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he had some forty descendants; executing them all was unbearable.

sentences.zh: 倘分別去留，又何從分別。

translations.literal: If some were spared and others not, how could one distinguish?
translations.idiomatic: To spare some and kill others offered no clear standard.

sentences.zh: 暫免其死，仍照前禁錮。

translations.literal: His death is temporarily spared; he remains confined as before.
translations.idiomatic: His life was spared for now and he remained under confinement as before.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict ended."

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jichou day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賴都罷，以常壽為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Laidu left office; Changshou was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Laidu was dismissed and Changshou became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，追封故平南大將軍賴塔為一等公，其孫博爾屯襲。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the late Pacification General of the South Laita was posthumously enfeoffed as first-class duke; his grandson Bo'ertun succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the late southern commander Laita was posthumously made first-class duke; his grandson Bo'ertun inherited.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，喀爾喀郡王額駙策凌與鄂羅斯使臣薩瓦定界，以恰克圖為貿易之所，理籓院派員管理。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Khalkha prince consort Celeng and the Russian envoy Sawa fixed the border; Kyakhta was set as the trading place, with officials of the Court of Colonial Affairs assigned to manage it.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Prince Celeng and Russian envoy Sawa fixed the border at Kyakhta as the trading post under Court of Colonial Affairs supervision.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，定官員頂戴之制。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin: regulations were fixed for officials' rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, rules for officials' rank insignia were established.

sentences.zh: 以孫柱為大學士，查弼納為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Sun Zhu was made Grand Secretary and Zhabina Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Zhu became Grand Secretary and Zhabina Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 己巳，鄂爾泰奏花苗內附，剿辦蒗蕖，平之，威遠裸苗內附。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Ortai memorialized that the Flowery Miao had submitted inland, Langji was suppressed and pacified, and the Weiyuan Luo Miao had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Ortai reported Flowery Miao submission, pacification of Langji, and Weiyuan Luo Miao allegiance.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，刑部議上蔡珽獄，大罪十八，應立斬，妻子入辛者庫。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Ministry of Punishments reported on Cai Ting's case: eighteen great crimes, warranting immediate decapitation; wife and children to enter the Sinicu Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Ministry of Punishments found Cai Ting guilty of eighteen capital crimes warranting immediate execution; his family to enter bondage.

sentences.zh: 得旨，改監候。

translations.literal: A rescript was received: the sentence was changed to imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the sentence commuted to imprisonment pending execution.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，命科道及吏部司官不必專用科目。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yiyou: censors and Ministry of Personnel bureau officials were no longer required to be examination degree-holders exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, censors and Ministry of Personnel officials need no longer be degree-holders only.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，王大臣會審隆科多獄上，大罪五十，應斬立決，妻子入辛者庫，財產入官。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, princes and ministers jointly reported on Longkodo's case: fifty great crimes, warranting immediate decapitation; wife and children to enter the Sinicu Bureau and property to be confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, ministers found Longkodo guilty of fifty capital crimes warranting execution; his family to enter bondage and property seized.

sentences.zh: 得旨，隆科多著禁錮。

translations.literal: A rescript was received: Longkodo is to be confined.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Longkodo imprisoned instead.

sentences.zh: 以博爾屯為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Bo'ertun was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Bo'ertun became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，命查郎阿、邁祿備邊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: Zhalang'a and Mailu were ordered to prepare frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Zhalang'a and Mailu were ordered to ready the frontier.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，加浙江巡撫李衛為總督。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Zhejiang Governor Li Wei was promoted to governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Zhejiang Governor Li Wei became governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，復鰲拜一等公，令其孫達福襲。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Oboi's first-class dukedom was restored; his grandson Dafu succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Oboi's first-class dukedom was restored to his grandson Dafu.

sentences.zh: 敕修執中成憲。

translations.literal: An edict ordered revision of the Zhizhong Chengxian.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered revision of the Zhizhong Chengxian.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，鄂爾泰奏貴州長寨後路克猛等一百八十四寨生苗內附。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Ortai memorialized that one hundred eighty-four stockades of the Kemeng and other tribes behind Changzhai in Guizhou had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Ortai reported 184 Guizhou stockades behind Changzhai had submitted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，守護景陵大學士蕭永藻坐失察公銜廣善越分請安，褫職，仍依前守陵。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Grand Secretary Xiao Yongzao, guardian of the Jing Mausoleum, was stripped of office for failing to detect that the honorary title-holder Guangshan had overstepped in requesting an audience; he continued tomb-guard duty as before.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, tomb guardian Grand Secretary Xiao Yongzao lost office for not catching Guangshan's improper audience request but kept guarding the mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣官清丈四川地畝。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, officials were dispatched to survey land acreage in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, officials were sent to measure Sichuan land.

sentences.zh: 順承郡王錫保以徇庇延信奪親王俸，仍停郡王俸三年。

translations.literal: Prince Shuncheng Xibao, for shielding Yansin, lost his prince's stipend but still had his commandery prince's stipend suspended for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shuncheng Xibao lost his stipend for shielding Yansin; his commandery prince stipend was suspended three years.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午朔，以那蘇圖為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day renwu: Nasutu was made general of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, Nasutu became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命直省學政每六年拔取生員一次。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, provincial education commissioners were ordered to select licentiates once every six years.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, provincial schools were ordered to promote licentiates every six years.

sentences.zh: 王大臣審擬貝勒延信大罪二十，應斬決。

translations.literal: Princes and ministers reported on Beile Yansin: twenty great crimes, warranting decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers found Beile Yansin guilty of twenty capital crimes warranting execution.

sentences.zh: 得旨，延信免死，與隆科多一處監禁。

translations.literal: A rescript was received: Yansin's death is spared; he is to be confined together with Longkodo.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor spared Yansin and imprisoned him with Longkodo.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，范時繹奏太倉州屬之七浦士民原自行修濬。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Fan Shiyi memorialized that the people of Qipu in Taicang prefecture had originally wished to dredge the works themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Fan Shiyi reported Taicang's Qipu residents had wanted to dredge the channel themselves.

sentences.zh: 上不許，曰：「民間之生計，即國計也。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not permit it and said: "The livelihood of the people is itself the revenue of the state.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused, saying, "Popular livelihood is national revenue.

sentences.zh: 國用不敷之時，不得不藉資民力。

translations.literal: When state revenue is insufficient, one must borrow from the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: When revenue falls short, the state must draw on popular labor.

sentences.zh: 方今國用充裕，仍發帑銀給之。

translations.literal: Now that state revenue is ample, treasury silver is still to be issued."
translations.idiomatic: Now that revenue is ample, treasury funds will still be provided."

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，左都御史沈近思卒。

translations.literal: " On day wuxu, Left Censor-in-chief Shen Jinshi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Left Censor-in-chief Shen Jinshi died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以唐執玉為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Tang Zhiyu was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Tang Zhiyu became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the joint temple sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江蘇、江西、浙江、福建、湖廣、廣東等省三十四州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for thirty-four prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Huguang, Guangdong, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in thirty-four districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、鄂羅斯入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Russia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Russia paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年戊申春正月己未，高其倬疏陳閩省械鬥情形。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day jiwei: Gao Qizhuo memorialized on the situation of armed clan fights in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the first day of spring, Gao Qizhuo reported on Fujian clan feuds.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「此等處須鼓舞屬員實心儘力，方能有濟。

translations.literal: A rescript was received: "In such places subordinates must be encouraged to serve wholeheartedly and with full effort—only then can there be results.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied that subordinates must be urged to work wholeheartedly or nothing would improve.

sentences.zh: 設遇一二有為者，甫欲整理，輒目為多事。

translations.literal: Whenever one or two capable men begin to put things in order, they are at once labeled as meddling.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever capable men tried to reform matters, they were called meddlers.

sentences.zh: 屬員窺見其隱，誰肯任怨向前。

translations.literal: Subordinates, seeing their intent, who would willingly take on blame and press forward?
translations.idiomatic: Seeing this, subordinates would not take on thankless work.

sentences.zh: 須知其難而終任之，二三年後始有成效也。

translations.literal: One must know the difficulty yet persevere in the task; only after two or three years will there be effect."
translations.idiomatic: Officials must accept the difficulty and persist; results would come only after two or three years."

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，晉封貝勒球琳為惠郡王，鎮國公弘春為貝子。

translations.literal: " On day yichou, Beile Qiulin was promoted to Prince Hui of the Commandery and State Duke Hongchun to beile.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Beile Qiulin became Prince Hui of the Commandery and Hongchun became beile.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命杭奕祿、任蘭枝使安南。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Hang Yilu and Ren Lanzhi were sent as envoys to Annam.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Hang Yilu and Ren Lanzhi were dispatched to Annam.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，晉封果郡王胤禮為親王。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu: Prince Guo of the Commandery Yinzhi was promoted to prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Prince Guo Yinzhi was raised to full prince.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以來文為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Lai Wen was made general at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Lai Wen became Jiangning general.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賜歸流永順土司彭肇槐世職，並白金萬兩。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Peng Zhaohuai of the returned Yongshun native office was granted a hereditary post and ten thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Peng Zhaohuai of Yongshun was granted a hereditary office and ten thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以嵇曾筠為兵部尚書，仍辦河工。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Ji Zengyun was made Minister of War while continuing to oversee river works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Ji Zengyun became Minister of War and kept charge of river works.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，大學士田從典罷，以蔣廷錫為大學士。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingsi: Grand Secretary Tian Congdian left office; Jiang Tingxi was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Tian Congdian left office and Jiang Tingxi became Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以進藏官兵駐劄西寧，命巡撫杭奕祿督之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, because troops entering Tibet were stationed at Xining, Governor Hang Yilu was ordered to supervise them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Hang Yilu was ordered to supervise Tibetan expedition troops stationed at Xining.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，以陳泰為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: Chen Tai was made Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Chen Tai became Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 予告大學士田從典卒。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Tian Congdian, on leave, died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Tian Congdian died while on leave.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以查郎阿、稽曾筠為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Zha Lang'a and Ji Zengyun were made Ministers of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Zha Lang'a and Ji Zengyun became Ministers of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔：「地方官私徵耗羨，難以裁革。

translations.literal: On day renyin, an edict said: "Local officials' private collection of surcharges is hard to abolish outright.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, an edict said local surcharge collection could not be fully abolished.

sentences.zh: 惟在督撫審慎用之，不可以歸公。

translations.literal: Governors and governors-general must use it cautiously and must not remit it to the public treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Governors were to use surcharges cautiously and not remit them to the treasury.

sentences.zh: 若歸公，則地方官又重複取民矣。

translations.literal: If it is remitted to the treasury, local officials will again levy doubly on the people.
translations.idiomatic: Remitting surcharges to the treasury would only make officials levy on the people again.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，以郭沭為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guichou: Guo Shu was made governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guichou day, Guo Shu became governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰奏剿辦東川逆苗祿天祐、祿世豪，平之，壬戌，詔：「八法內年老一條，義有未盡。

translations.literal: E'ertai reported suppressing rebel Miao Lu Tianyou and Lu Shihao in Dongchuan and pacifying them; on day renxu, an edict said: "The 'advanced age' provision among the Eight Regulations is not fully satisfactory in meaning.
translations.idiomatic: E'ertai reported pacifying Dongchuan rebel Miao; on renxu day, an edict revised the Eight Regulations' age rule.

sentences.zh: 凡年老而能辦事者，勿入八法。

translations.literal: Those advanced in age but still able to handle affairs shall not be placed under the Eight Regulations."
translations.idiomatic: Capable elderly officials were exempted from the Eight Regulations."

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，削富寧安侯爵，仍為大學士。

translations.literal: " On day dingmao, Funing'an's marquis rank was stripped; he remained Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Funing'an lost his marquisate but stayed Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 命馬爾賽在大學士內辦事。

translations.literal: Ma'ersai was ordered to handle affairs among the Grand Secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: Ma'ersai was ordered to manage Grand Secretariat business.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以田文鏡為河東總督，兼轄山東。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Tian Wenjing was made governor-general of Hedong, with concurrent jurisdiction over Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Tian Wenjing became Hedong governor-general, also overseeing Shandong.

sentences.zh: 以耿化祚為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Geng Huazuo was made Han Chinese Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Huazuo became Han Banner commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，詔六部員外郎、主事作為公缺，勿庸按旗升轉。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: an edict made sixth-rank secretaries and seventh-rank clerks open posts without banner rotation for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, ministry clerks were made open posts free of banner promotion rules.

sentences.zh: 癸未，置先賢仲弓後裔五經博士。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, a Five Classics Erudite post was established for a descendant of the ancient sage Zhong Gong.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, a Five Classics Erudite was appointed for Zhong Gong's descendant.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以蔡良為廣州將軍，石禮哈為福州將軍，尹繼善協辦江南河工。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Cai Liang was made general at Guangzhou, Shi Liha general at Fuzhou, and Yin Jishan was assigned to assist on Jiangnan river works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Cai Liang and Shi Liha became generals; Yin Jishan assisted Jiangnan river works.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以張廣泗為貴州巡撫，岳濬署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Zhang Guangsi was made governor of Guizhou and Yue Jun acting governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Zhang Guangsi became Guizhou governor and Yue Jun acting Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，誠親王胤祉有罪降郡王，拘其子弘晟於宗人府。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Prince Cheng Yin Zhi was demoted to commandery prince for crimes; his son Hongsheng was detained in the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Prince Cheng Yin Zhi was demoted and his son Hongsheng was detained.

sentences.zh: 封理密親王子弘曣為輔國公。

translations.literal: Prince Limi's son Hong Yan was enfeoffed as Defender Duke of the State.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Limi's son Hong Yan was made Defender Duke of the State.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，命李衛兼理江蘇緝捕。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinhai: Li Wei was ordered to take concurrent charge of arrest work in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Li Wei was ordered to oversee Jiangsu arrests.

sentences.zh: 戊午，鄂爾泰奏遣兵剿平川境米貼逆苗。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, E'ertai reported dispatching troops to suppress rebel Miao at Mitie in Pingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, E'ertai reported suppressing rebel Miao at Mitie in Pingchuan.

sentences.zh: 命以其事屬四川提督黃廷桂。

translations.literal: The matter was placed under Sichuan provincial commander Huang Tinggui.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign was placed under Sichuan commander Huang Tinggui.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，岳鍾琪奏頗羅鼐兵至西藏，喇嘛擒獻阿爾布巴、隆布奈、扎爾鼐等，西藏平。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yue Zhongqi reported Poluonai's troops reaching Tibet; lamas captured and presented Arbu Ba, Longbunai, Zha'ertai, and others; Tibet was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yue Zhongqi reported Tibet pacified after rebel leaders were captured.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以紀成斌為固原提督。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Ji Chengbin was made provincial commander of Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Ji Chengbin became Guyuan provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大學士富寧安卒。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Grand Secretary Funing'an died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Grand Secretary Funing'an died.

sentences.zh: 賜故大學士寧完我三世孫寧蘭驍騎校，房一所，銀五百，四世孫寧邦璽拜唐阿。

translations.literal: The late Grand Secretary Ning Wanwo's third-generation descendant Ning Lan was granted captaincy in the Deliberately Fearless Cavalry, one residence, and five hundred taels of silver; the fourth-generation descendant Ning Bangxi received the title Baitang'a.
translations.idiomatic: Ning Wanwo's descendants Ning Lan and Ning Bangxi received offices, a house, silver, and a title.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiashen: the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiashen day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 以尹繼善署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Yin Jishan was made acting governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jishan became acting Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改湖廣桑植、保靖二土司為流官。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the two native chieftaincies of Sangzhi and Baojing in Huguang were converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Sangzhi and Baojing in Huguang were converted to regular administration.

sentences.zh: 以馬爾賽為大學士。

translations.literal: Ma'ersai was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Ma'ersai became Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以祖秉衡為京口將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Zu Bingheng was made general at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Zu Bingheng became Jingkou general.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔復浙江鄉會試。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, an edict restored the provincial and metropolitan examinations in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Zhejiang provincial and metropolitan examinations were restored.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，命八旗勛舊子孫有犯法虧帑者，察實以聞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guichou: an order required that descendants of meritorious Eight Banner families who broke the law or caused treasury deficits be investigated and reported when verified.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, meritorious banner descendants who broke the law were to be investigated and reported.

sentences.zh: 漢員中陣亡盡節及居官清正之子孫，同此察報。

translations.literal: Children and grandchildren of Han officials who died in battle or served with integrity were to be reported under the same procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of loyal or upright Han officials were reported the same way.

sentences.zh: 天津水師營都統公鄂齊以失察兵丁傷官削爵，降三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Grand Duke E Qi, commanding the Tianjin naval camp, had his title stripped for failure to supervise soldiers who wounded an official; he was demoted to third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: E Qi lost his title and was demoted for failing to stop soldiers who wounded an official.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，查郎阿奏領兵至藏，會同副都統馬喇、學士僧格訊明逆首阿爾布巴等，立時正法，餘眾處置訖。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Zha Lang'a reported leading troops to Tibet; together with Vice Commander-in-chief Mara and Academician Sengge they examined the rebel leaders Arbu Ba and others, executed them at once, and disposed of the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Zha Lang'a reported executing Tibetan rebel leaders and disposing of the rest.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，以鄂爾泰剿平廣西八達寨逆苗，兼督雲、貴、廣西三省，發帑銀十萬犒滇、黔兵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dinghai: for E'ertai's suppression of rebel Miao at Badazhai in Guangxi, he was given concurrent supervision of Yunnan, Guizhou, and Guangxi; one hundred thousand taels were issued from the treasury to reward Yunnan and Guizhou troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, E'ertai was given three-province supervision and one hundred thousand taels to reward troops.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，發內帑九十四萬代西征軍士賠償追款。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, nine hundred forty thousand taels from the inner treasury were issued to cover indemnities and recovered funds for soldiers on the western expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, 940,000 taels were issued for western expedition indemnities.

sentences.zh: 以石文焯為禮部尚書，路振揚為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Shi Wenchao was made Minister of Rites and Lu Zhenyang Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Wenchao and Lu Zhenyang became Ministers of Rites and War.

sentences.zh: 乙未，岳鍾琪奏建昌喇汝窩番賊作亂，討平之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Yue Zhongqi reported Tibetan bandits at Lawuwo in Jianchang in revolt; they were suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Yue Zhongqi reported suppressing Jianchang Tibetan rebels.

sentences.zh: 詔：「湖廣土司甚多，供職輸將，與流官無異，該督撫勿得輕議改流。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Huguang has many native chieftains who perform duties and pay tribute no differently from regular officials; governors must not lightly propose converting them to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: An edict warned governors not to lightly convert Huguang native chieftains to regular administration.

sentences.zh: 」以蔡仕舢為浙江觀風整俗使。

translations.literal: " Cai Shishan was made Zhejiang moral-reform commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Shishan became Zhejiang moral-reform commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，諭停諸王管理旗務。

translations.literal: On day guisi, an instruction ordered princes to cease managing banner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, princes were ordered to stop managing banner affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，設咸安宮官學，包衣子弟肄業。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: the Xian'an Palace official school was established for booi bondsmen to study.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Xian'an Palace school was opened for booi students.

sentences.zh: 庚申，停本年決囚。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, executions for the year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，江西巡撫布蘭泰以不職免。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Jiangxi Governor Burantai was dismissed for incompetence.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Jiangxi Governor Burantai was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 添設欽天監西洋人監副一。

translations.literal: One additional Western assistant director was added at the Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: A Western assistant director was added at the Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，免四川崇慶州七年額賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiawu: seven years of quota land tax for Chongqing prefecture in Sichuan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, seven years of Chongqing tax were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大清律集解附例成。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Completed Qing Code with Collected Explanations and Appended Precedents was finished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Completed Qing Code with Explanations and Precedents was finished.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以定藏功封頗羅鼐為貝子，理後藏事，揀選噶隆二人理前藏事，賞其兵丁銀三萬兩。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, for pacifying Tibet Poluonai was enfeoffed as beile to administer rear Tibet; two kalons were selected to administer front Tibet; his soldiers were rewarded with thirty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Poluonai was enfeoffed to rule Tibet; kalons were chosen and troops rewarded.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命侍郎王璣、彭維新往江南清查逋賦。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Vice Ministers Wang Ji and Peng Weixin were ordered to Jiangnan to investigate delinquent taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Wang Ji and Peng Weixin were sent to Jiangnan to investigate tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the joint seasonal sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the joint seasonal sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、陝西、四川等省二十六州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for twenty-six prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in twenty-six districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年己酉春正月辛亥，鄂爾泰奏萬壽節日，雲南慶雲見。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day xinhai: E'ertai reported that on the Longevity Festival auspicious clouds appeared in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the first day of spring, E'ertai reported auspicious clouds in Yunnan on the Longevity Festival.

sentences.zh: 命宣付史館。

translations.literal: An order was issued to announce this to the Historiographical Institute.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the event recorded in the Historiographical Institute.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命陳元龍、尹泰為大學士。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Chen Yuanlong and Yin Tai were made Grand Secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Chen Yuanlong and Yin Tai became Grand Secretaries.

sentences.zh: 壬申，復蒙古恩格德爾侯爵為三等公，以其曾孫噶爾薩襲。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Mongol Enggeder's marquisate was restored to third-rank duke, inherited by his great-grandson Ga'ersa.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Enggeder's title was restored as third-rank duke for his great-grandson Ga'ersa.

sentences.zh: 蒙古二等伯明安晉封一等侯，令其孫馬蘭泰襲。

translations.literal: Mongol second-rank count Ming'an was promoted to first-rank marquis; his grandson Malantai inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Ming'an was promoted to first-rank marquis; his grandson Malantai inherited.

sentences.zh: 都統伯四格有罪監禁，上念其祖莽固爾岱之功，釋之。

translations.literal: Commander-in-chief fourth-rank count Si Ge was imprisoned for crimes; the Emperor, remembering his grandfather Manggu'erdai's merit, released him.
translations.idiomatic: Si Ge was imprisoned but released in memory of his grandfather Manggu'erdai's merit.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命侍郎法保等察修直隸至江南大道。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Vice Minister Fabao and others were ordered to inspect and repair the main road from Zhili to Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Fabao and others were ordered to repair the Zhili–Jiangnan highway.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，命出征官兵行糧外仍給坐糧。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: expedition troops were ordered to receive sitting grain rations in addition to marching grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, expedition troops received sitting grain as well as marching grain.

sentences.zh: 以尹繼善為河道總督。

translations.literal: Yin Jishan was made Director-General of Rivers and Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jishan became Director-General of Rivers and Waterways.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以多索禮為奉天將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Duosuoli was made general at Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Duosuoli became Fengtian general.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，還京。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 設直隸巡農御史。

translations.literal: A Zhili agricultural inspection censor was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Zhili agricultural inspection censor was appointed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命怡親王等查八旗世職有以絕嗣除爵者，許以族人紹封。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Prince Yi and others were ordered to investigate banner hereditary posts vacated for lack of heirs; clansmen might be allowed to continue the title.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Prince Yi was ordered to allow clansmen to continue vacant banner titles.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 以李杕為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Li Shu was made Han Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shu became Han Banner commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 蠲浙江本年額賦六十萬兩。

translations.literal: Zhejiang's annual quota land tax of six hundred thousand taels was remitted for the year.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's annual land tax of six hundred thousand taels was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳朔，以孔毓珂為江南河道總督，郝玉麟為廣東總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day yisi, first day of the month: Kong Yu'e was made Director-General of Jiangnan Rivers; Hao Yulin governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the third month, Kong Yu'e and Hao Yulin received new appointments.

sentences.zh: 岳鍾琪奏剿平雷波叛苗一百餘寨。

translations.literal: Yue Zhongqi reported suppressing over one hundred rebel Miao stockades at Leibo.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi reported pacifying more than one hundred Leibo rebel stockades.

sentences.zh: 戊申，鄂爾泰奏剿平丹江、九股等處生苗。

translations.literal: On day wushen, E'ertai reported suppressing raw Miao at Danjiang, Jiugu, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, E'ertai reported pacifying raw Miao at Danjiang and Jiugu.

sentences.zh: 蠲河南本年額賦四十萬兩。

translations.literal: Henan's annual quota land tax of four hundred thousand taels was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's annual land tax of four hundred thousand taels was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以嵇曾筠為河南山東總督。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Ji Zengyun was made governor-general of Henan and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Ji Zengyun became Henan–Shandong governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上以準噶爾噶爾丹策零稔惡藏奸，終為邊患，命傅爾丹為靖邊大將軍，北路出師，岳鍾琪為寧遠大將軍，西路出師，征討準噶爾。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, because Dzungar Galdan Tsering was deeply wicked and treacherous and would ultimately menace the frontier, Fu Erdan was made Great General for Pacifying the Frontier for the northern route and Yue Zhongqi Great General for Pacifying the Distance for the western route to campaign against Dzungaria.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Fu Erdan and Yue Zhongqi were made generals to campaign against Dzungaria.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以鄂善、莽鵠立俱為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, E Shan and Mang Hulu were both made Mongol commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, E Shan and Mang Hulu became Mongol commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔公巴賽為副將軍，順承郡王錫保為振武將軍，陳泰、袞泰、石禮哈、岱豪、達福、海蘭為參贊，旗兵六千，三省兵八千，蒙古兵八百，歸北路，駐紮阿爾泰；

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict made Gongbasei deputy general, Prince Xun of the Commandery Xibao Pacifying Martial General, with Chen Tai, Guntai, Shi Liha, Daihao, Dafu, and Hailan as advisers; six thousand banner troops, eight thousand from three provinces, and eight hundred Mongol troops were assigned to the northern route, encamped at Altai;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, generals and advisers were appointed and northern-route forces encamped at Altai;

sentences.zh: 總兵官魏麟、閃文綉領車騎營兵八千，赴西路布爾庫。

translations.literal: Brigadier-generals Wei Lin and Shan Wenxiu led eight thousand cavalry camp troops to the western route at Bur Ha.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Lin and Shan Wenxiu led eight thousand cavalry to the western route at Bur Ha.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，以查郎阿署川陝總督，史貽直署福建總督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: Zha Lang'a was made acting governor-general of Shaanxi and Sichuan; Shi Yizhi acting governor-general of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Zha Lang'a and Shi Yizhi became acting governors-general.

sentences.zh: 敕建雲、雨、風、雷壇廟。

translations.literal: An imperial order established altars and temples to Cloud, Rain, Wind, and Thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Altars and temples to Cloud, Rain, Wind, and Thunder were ordered built.

sentences.zh: 四川天全土司改流設州。

translations.literal: Sichuan's Tianquan native chieftaincy was converted to regular administration and made a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's Tianquan chieftaincy was converted to a regular prefecture.

sentences.zh: 高其倬劾海澄公黃應纘行賄承襲，應革職銜。

translations.literal: Gao Qizhuo impeached Marquis Haicheng Huang Yingzuan for bribing to inherit his title; he should be stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qizhuo urged stripping Huang Yingzuan for bribing to inherit his marquisate.

sentences.zh: 詔寬免之。

translations.literal: An edict granted leniency.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor granted leniency.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，湖南保靖、桑植、永順三土司改流設府縣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuwu: the three Huguang chieftaincies Baojing, Sangzhi, and Yongshun were converted to regular administration with prefectures and counties established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Baojing, Sangzhi, and Yongshun were converted to regular prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 甲子，令漕船順帶商貨，於舊例六十石外，許至百石。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, grain transport boats were permitted to carry merchant goods up to one hundred piculs beyond the former limit of sixty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, transport boats could carry up to one hundred piculs of merchant goods.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，先是，岳鍾琪疏言有湖南人張熙投遞逆書，訊由其師曾靜所使。

translations.literal: On day yichou: earlier, Yue Zhongqi memorialized that a Hunan man Zhang Xi had delivered a seditious letter; examination showed his teacher Zeng Jing had sent him.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Yue Zhongqi reported Zhang Xi's seditious letter came from his teacher Zeng Jing.

sentences.zh: 命提曾靜、張熙至京。

translations.literal: Zeng Jing and Zhang Xi were ordered brought to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Jing and Zhang Xi were ordered to the capital.

sentences.zh: 九卿會訊，曾靜供因讀已故呂留良所著書，陷溺狂悖。

translations.literal: The Nine Ministers jointly examined them; Zeng Jing confessed that reading books by the late Lü Liuliang had led him into frantic heterodoxy.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers examined them; Zeng Jing blamed Lü Liuliang's books for his heterodoxy.

sentences.zh: 至是，明詔斥責呂留良，並令中外臣工議罪。

translations.literal: At this point a clear edict condemned Lü Liuliang and ordered civil and military officials at home and abroad to deliberate on his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict condemned Lü Liuliang and ordered officials to deliberate his punishment.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，以唐執玉署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jimao: Tang Zhiyu was made acting governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Tang Zhiyu became acting Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以甘肅、四川、雲南、貴州、廣西轉輸勞費，免庚戌全年額賦，陝西免十分之三。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because transport costs were heavy in Gansu, Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, and Guangxi, the full gengxu year's quota tax was remitted; Shaanxi received a three-tenths remission.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, full tax remissions were granted to western provinces; Shaanxi received partial relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，貴州都勻生苗及儂、仲生苗內附。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingwu: raw Miao of Duyun in Guizhou and Nong and Zhong raw Miao submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Guizhou raw Miao of Duyun, Nong, and Zhong submitted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以果親王胤禮管工部，庄親王胤祿管滿洲都統。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Prince Guo Yin Li was put in charge of the Ministry of Works and Prince Zhuang Yin Lu of the Manchu commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Prince Guo Yin Li took the Works Ministry and Prince Zhuang Yin Lu the Manchu command.

sentences.zh: 己巳，減暹羅國貢賦。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Siam's tribute levy was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Siam's tribute was reduced.

sentences.zh: 閏七月乙酉，以阿里袞為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day yiyou: Arigun was made general at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, Arigun became Hangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，以王釴為京口將軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao: Wang Qin was made general at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Wang Qin became Jingkou general.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，改廣西鎮安為流。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi: Guangxi's Zhen'an was converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Guangxi's Zhen'an was converted to regular administration.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，賜漢大臣子蔣溥等十三人舉人。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengxu: thirteen sons of Han ministers including Jiang Pu were granted licentiate status.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengxu day, thirteen sons of Han officials including Jiang Pu received licentiate degrees.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔曰：「江南清查逋賦一案，歷降諭旨甚明，重在分別官侵民欠。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict said: "In the Jiangnan investigation of arrears in land tax, repeated imperial instructions have been very clear, emphasizing distinction between official embezzlement and popular arrears.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, an edict said the Jiangnan tax-arrears inquiry must distinguish official embezzlement from popular debt.

sentences.zh: 乃派往之員辦理不善，有以紳衿帶徵之項指為官侵者，有吏書侵蝕之項議令富戶攤賠者。

translations.literal: Yet the officers sent to handle it did poorly: some treated items the gentry collected on behalf of the tax as official embezzlement; some proposed that items clerks had embezzled be assessed on wealthy households.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners mishandled the case, calling gentry collections official theft or shifting clerk embezzlement onto rich households.

sentences.zh: 又有將帶徵錢糧加增火耗者，甚且以停徵之項概令徵收者。

translations.literal: Some even added surcharge fees to collected tax grain; some even broadly collected items that had been suspended from collection.
translations.idiomatic: Some added illegal surcharges or collected levies that had been suspended.

sentences.zh: 惠民之政，轉而擾民，豈非司其事者之咎乎？

translations.literal: A policy meant to benefit the people was turned into harassment of the people—is this not the fault of those in charge of the matter?
translations.idiomatic: A relief policy became harassment—is that not the fault of those in charge?

sentences.zh: 其恪遵前旨妥辦。

translations.literal: Strictly follow the previous instructions and handle it properly.
translations.idiomatic: They were ordered to follow prior instructions and handle matters properly.

sentences.zh: 倘再犯諸弊，從重治罪。

translations.literal: If these abuses occur again, punish severely according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Repeat offenders were to be punished severely.

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，以內外諸臣勤慎奉職，加怡親王儀仗一倍，張廷玉少保，蔣廷錫太子太傅，勵廷儀太子少傅，傅爾丹、岳鍾琪、鄂爾泰俱少保，田文鏡太子太保，李衛、查郎阿、席伯俱太子少保。

translations.literal: " On day wuchen, because civil and military officials within and outside the court were diligent and careful in their posts, Prince Yi's ceremonial regalia was increased twofold; Zhang Tingyu was made Lesser Guardian; Jiang Tingxi Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Li Tingyi Junior Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Fu Erdan, Yue Zhongqi, and E'ertai all Lesser Guardian; Tian Wenjing Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Li Wei, Zhalang'a, and Xibo all Junior Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, diligent ministers were rewarded: Prince Yi's regalia doubled; Zhang Tingyu, Jiang Tingxi, Li Tingyi, Fu Erdan, Yue Zhongqi, E'ertai, Tian Wenjing, Li Wei, Zhalang'a, and Xibo received honors.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，發帑金百萬兩修高家堰石工。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiaxu: one million taels from the treasury were issued to repair stone works at Gaojia Embankment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, one million taels were issued to repair Gaojia Embankment stone works.

sentences.zh: 以馬會伯為兵部尚書，仍留軍前。

translations.literal: Ma Huibo was appointed Minister of War while remaining at the army front.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Huibo became Minister of War but remained with the army.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免功臣子孫施世驊等贓銀五十餘萬，以內庫銀撥補，其應得遣戍、監追、籍沒及妻子入官等罪，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, more than five hundred thousand taels in embezzled silver owed by descendants of meritorious officials including Shi Shihua was pardoned; the shortfall was made up from the inner treasury; crimes of exile, supervised recovery, confiscation of property, and wives and children entering official status were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, over five hundred thousand taels owed by meritorious families including Shi Shihua were forgiven from the inner treasury, with related punishments remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊子，停本年決囚。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, executions for the year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, executions for the year were halted.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，設廣東觀風整俗使及肇高學政。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: the Guangdong Commissioner for Inspecting Customs and Reforming Customs was established, as was the Zhaogao educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Guangdong inspection and Zhaogao educational posts were established.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, joint worship was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, joint ancestral worship was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江南、江西、浙江、福建、湖南、雲南、甘肅等省二十四州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for twenty-four prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Yunnan, Gansu, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas across Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Yunnan, Gansu, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年庚戌春正月丁丑，以總理陵寢事務領侍衛內大臣尚崇廙為盛京五部尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, day dingchou: Shang Chongkuo, inner palace grand minister in charge of mausoleum affairs and palace guards, was made Minister of the Five Boards at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on dingchou day in the first month, Shang Chongkuo became Mukden Minister of the Five Boards.

sentences.zh: 以那蘇圖為奉天將軍，常德為寧古塔將軍，卓爾海為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Nasutu was made Mukden general, Changde Ningguta general, and Zhuo'erhai Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: Nasutu, Changde, and Zhuo'erhai were appointed frontier generals.

sentences.zh: 以慶復為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Qing Fu was made Han Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Fu became Han Banner commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，景陵瑞芝生。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, auspicious fungus grew at Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, auspicious fungus appeared at Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，唐執玉奏正月二十日鳳凰見於房山。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Tang Zhiyu memorialized that on the twentieth of the first month a phoenix had been seen at Fangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Tang Zhiyu reported a phoenix sighting at Fangshan on the twentieth of the first month.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「此事已據府尹孫家淦奏報。

translations.literal: Edict received: "This matter was already reported by Prefect Sun Jiagan.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said Sun Jiagan had already reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 又據尚崇廙報稱天台山中見一神鳥，高五六尺，毛羽如錦，群鳥環繞，向北飛去。

translations.literal: Shang Chongkuo also reported that in Mount Tiantai a divine bird was seen, five or six chi tall, with feathers like brocade, surrounded by a flock of birds, flying northward.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Chongkuo also reported a divine bird on Mount Tiantai, five or six chi tall, with brocade-like plumage, flying north amid other birds.

sentences.zh: 朕躬德薄，未足致此上瑞。

translations.literal: Our person's virtue is thin, insufficient to bring about such a supreme omen."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said his virtue was too slight to merit such an omen."

sentences.zh: 」發國子監膏火銀六千兩，歲以為常。

translations.literal: Six thousand taels of stipend silver for the Imperial Academy were issued, to be annual.
translations.idiomatic: Six thousand taels of Imperial Academy stipend silver were granted annually.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子朔，定外戚錫爵曰承恩公。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi, first day of the month: the title for ennobling maternal relatives was fixed as Bearer of Imperial Grace Duke.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month's new moon of gengzi day, the maternal-kin title Bearer of Imperial Grace Duke was fixed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，復賴士公爵。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Lai Shi was restored to ducal rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Lai Shi was restored to duke.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，復誠郡王胤祉為誠親王，貝勒胤烜為愉郡王，貝子胤禕為貝勒，皇二十一弟胤禧、皇二十二弟胤祜為貝子，皇二十三弟胤祁為鎮國公。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Prince Cheng Yin Zhi was restored to Prince Cheng, Prince Yu Yin Xuan to Prince Yu, Beizi Yin Shen to beile rank, Imperial younger brothers Yin Xi and Yin Hu to beizi rank, and Yin Qi to Defender Duke of the State.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Yin Zhi, Yin Xuan, Yin Shen, Yin Xi, Yin Hu, and Yin Qi received restored ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，南掌國遣使來貢，請定貢期。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Nan Zhang sent envoys with tribute, requesting a fixed tribute schedule.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Nan Zhang sent tribute envoys seeking a fixed schedule.

sentences.zh: 上優詔答之，命五年一貢。

translations.literal: The Emperor graciously replied and ordered tribute once every five years.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor graciously ordered tribute every five years.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，命張廷玉、蔣廷錫管理三庫事務。

translations.literal: Third month, day dinghai: Zhang Tingyu and Jiang Tingxi were ordered to manage the affairs of the Three Treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Zhang Tingyu and Jiang Tingxi were put in charge of the Three Treasuries.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以史貽直署兩江總督，頒行聖祖御纂書經傳說，上制序文。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Shi Yizhi was made acting governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi; the Sacred Ancestor's personally compiled Commentary on the Book of Documents was promulgated, with an imperial preface by the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Shi Yizhi became acting Jiangnan governor-general and the Sacred Ancestor's Book of Documents commentary was issued with an imperial preface.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，淳親王胤祐薨，諡曰度，以子弘暻襲郡王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Prince Chun Yin You died, posthumous title Du; his son Hong Jue inherited as commandery prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Prince Chun Yin You died with posthumous name Du; his son Hong Jue inherited.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賜周澍等三百九十九人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Zhou Shu and three hundred ninety-nine others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Zhou Shu and 399 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 丁未，定大學士為正一品，左都御史為從一品。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Grand Secretary was fixed as positive first rank and Censor-in-chief of the Left as secondary first rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Grand Secretary and Left Censor-in-chief ranks were fixed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以嵇曾筠署江南河道總督，田文鏡兼理東河總督。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Ji Zengyun was made acting Jiangnan Canal governor-general; Tian Wenjing concurrently managed the Eastern Canal governor-generalship.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Ji Zengyun became acting canal governor-general and Tian Wenjing also managed the Eastern Canal.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，怡親王胤祥薨，上痛悼之，親臨其喪，諡曰賢，配享太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei: Prince Yi Yinxiang died; the Emperor grieved deeply, personally attended the funeral, posthumous title Xian, and granted sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Prince Yi Yinxiang died; the Emperor mourned him, attended the funeral, gave posthumous name Xian, and granted ancestral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，噶爾丹策零遣使通問。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Galdan Tseren sent envoys to pay respects.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Galdan Tseren sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 命暫緩師期，召傅爾丹、岳鍾琪來京。

translations.literal: The campaign schedule was temporarily deferred, and Fu Erdan and Yue Zhongqi were summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign was deferred and Fu Erdan and Yue Zhongqi were recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 移高其倬為兩江總督，劉世明為福建總督。

translations.literal: Gao Qizhuo was moved to governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi; Liu Shiming was made Fujian governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qizhuo became Jiangnan governor-general and Liu Shiming Fujian governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上再臨怡賢親王喪。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor again attended Prince Yi the Worthy's funeral.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor again attended Prince Yi's funeral.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕諸兄弟之名，皆皇考所賜。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The names of all Our brothers were granted by Our late father.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said all imperial brothers' names had been granted by the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 即位之初，胤祉援例陳請更改上一字，奏明母后，勉強行之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Our reign Yin Zhi petitioned by precedent to change the upper character; this was reported to the Empress Dowager and reluctantly carried out.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the reign Yin Zhi had changed one character in his name after reporting to the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 今怡親王薨逝，王名仍書原字，志朕思念。

translations.literal: Now that Prince Yi has passed away, his princely name is still written with the original character, to record Our longing."
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Yi's death, his original name character was kept in writing to show the Emperor's longing."

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，先是，誠親王胤祉會怡賢親王之喪，遲到早散，面無戚容，交宗人府議處。

translations.literal: " On day xinmao: earlier, Prince Cheng Yin Zhi had attended Prince Yi the Worthy's funeral, arriving late and leaving early, showing no grief on his face; the Imperial Clan Court was ordered to deliberate punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Yin Zhi was reported for arriving late, leaving early, and showing no grief at Prince Yi's funeral.

sentences.zh: 至是，議上，請削爵正法。

translations.literal: At this time the deliberation was submitted, requesting stripping of title and execution according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The clan court recommended stripping his title and executing him.

sentences.zh: 得旨，削爵拘禁。

translations.literal: Edict received: he was stripped of title and placed under confinement.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor stripped his title and placed him under confinement.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以岳超龍為湖廣提督。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Yue Chaolong was made Huguang provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Yue Chaolong became Huguang provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 乙未，晉封貝子胤禧為貝勒，理郡王弘晰為親王，公弘景為貝子。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Beizi Yin Xi was promoted to beile, Prince of the Principality of Li Hong Xi to prince, and Duke Hong Jing to beizi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Yin Xi, Hong Xi, and Hong Jing were promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 復胤祹郡王。

translations.literal: Yin Shan was restored to commandery prince.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Shan was restored to commandery prince.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuxu, first day of the month: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month's new moon of wuxu day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賜怡賢親王「忠敬誠直勤慎廉明」八字加於諡上。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Prince Yi the Worthy was granted the eight characters "Loyal, respectful, sincere, upright, diligent, careful, incorrupt, and enlightened" added to his posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, eight honorific characters were added to Prince Yi's posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 戊申，鄂爾泰奏黎平、都勻生苗內附。

translations.literal: On day wushen, E'ertai memorialized that raw Miao of Liping and Duyun submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, E'ertai reported submission of raw Miao in Liping and Duyun.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，馬會伯免，以唐執玉為兵部尚書，史貽直為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Ma Huibo was dismissed; Tang Zhiyu was made Minister of War, and Shi Yizhi Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Ma Huibo was dismissed; Tang Zhiyu became Minister of War and Shi Yizhi Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，命建賢良祠。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuyin: construction of the Shrine of Worthy Officials was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuyin day, the Shrine of Worthy Officials was ordered built.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣官賑江南、湖南、直隸、山東等處被水災民。

translations.literal: On day renchen, officials were dispatched to relieve the people in Jiangnan, Hunan, Zhili, Shandong, and elsewhere stricken by flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, officials were sent to relieve flood victims in Jiangnan, Hunan, Zhili, Shandong, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命巡撫班次在副都統之上。

translations.literal: On day guisi, it was ordered that in precedence rankings provincial governors rank above vice commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, provincial governors were ranked above vice commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，以山東被水較重，特免通省漕糧。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingwu: because Shandong flooding was especially severe, all grain transport tax for the whole province was specially exempted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, all Shandong grain transport tax was exempted because flooding was severe.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命怡賢親王子弘曉襲封親王，弘晈別封郡王，均世襲。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Prince Yi the Worthy's son Hong Xiao was ordered to inherit as prince, and Hong Jiao separately enfeoffed as commandery prince, both hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Hong Xiao inherited Prince Yi's princedom and Hong Jiao was enfeoffed as commandery prince, both hereditarily.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，京師地震。

translations.literal: On day yimao, there was an earthquake in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the capital was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 康親王崇安停管宗人府事，以裕親王廣祿管宗人府。

translations.literal: Prince Kang Chong'an was removed from managing the Imperial Clan Court; Prince Yu Guanglu was put in charge of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Kang Chong'an was removed from the clan court and Prince Yu Guanglu put in charge.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，以京師地震，賜百官半俸，賜八旗銀各三萬兩。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingmao: because of the capital earthquake, civil officials were granted half salary and each Banner three thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, after the earthquake officials received half salary and each Banner three thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以高其倬相視太平峪吉地，予世職。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Gao Qizhuo was sent to survey auspicious ground at Taiping Valley and granted a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Gao Qizhuo surveyed Taiping Valley and received a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鄂爾泰奏猛弄白氏、孟連、怒子內附。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, E'ertai memorialized that Mengnong Bai clan, Menglian, and Nuzi submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, E'ertai reported submission of Mengnong Bai, Menglian, and Nuzi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，再定百官帽頂，一品官珊瑚頂，二品官起花珊瑚頂，三品官藍色明玻璃頂，四品官青金石頂，五品官水晶頂，六品官硨磲頂，七品官素金頂，八品官起花金頂，九品、未入流起花銀頂。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi: hats and peaks of all officials were re-fixed—first rank coral peak, second rank carved coral peak, third rank blue transparent glass peak, fourth rank lapis lazuli peak, fifth rank crystal peak, sixth rank giant clam peak, seventh rank plain gold peak, eighth rank carved gold peak, ninth rank and below carved silver peak.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, official hat insignia were re-fixed by rank from coral to silver.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命查弼納為副將軍，往北路軍營。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Zhabina was ordered made vice general and sent to the northern route army camp.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Zhabina was sent as vice general to the northern army.

sentences.zh: 壬子，鄂爾泰奏恢復烏蒙府城，苗黨平。

translations.literal: On day renzi, E'ertai memorialized recovery of Wumeng prefectural city; the Miao bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, E'ertai reported recovery of Wumeng and pacification of the Miao.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以馬爾賽、張廷玉、蔣廷錫久參機務，各予伯爵世襲。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, because Ma'ersai, Zhang Tingyu, and Jiang Tingxi had long served in confidential posts, each was granted a hereditary earldom.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Ma'ersai, Zhang Tingyu, and Jiang Tingxi each received a hereditary earldom.

sentences.zh: 闕里文廟成，命皇五子弘晝、淳郡王弘暻前往告祭。

translations.literal: When the Confucian temple at Qufu was completed, the fifth imperial son Hong Zhou and Prince Chun Hong Jue were ordered to go announce the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When Qufu's Confucian temple was completed, Hong Zhou and Hong Jue were sent to announce the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，設孔廟執事官。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi: officiating officials at the Confucian temple were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Confucian temple officiants were established.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命各省落地稅、契稅勿苛索求盈。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the provinces were ordered not to demand excessive landing tax and deed tax for surplus.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, provinces were forbidden to exact excessive landing and deed taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙子，明詔申飭漢軍勛裔獲咎大員范時繹、尚崇廙、李永升等。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, an imperial proclamation sternly admonished Han Banner descendants of meritorious families who had offended, including Fan Shiyi, Shang Chongkuo, and Li Yongsheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the court admonished offending Han Banner descendants of meritorious houses, including Fan Shiyi, Shang Chongkuo, and Li Yongsheng.

sentences.zh: 戊子，敕各省解部銀兩，留其半以充公用。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the provinces were ordered that when sending silver to the ministry they retain half for public use.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, provinces were told to keep half of silver sent to the ministry for public use.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，命傅爾丹、岳鍾琪各回本軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingyou: Fu Erdan and Yue Zhongqi were each ordered to return to their armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Fu Erdan and Yue Zhongqi were ordered back to their armies.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，紀成斌奏準噶爾賊眾犯闊舍圖卡倫，總兵樊廷擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Ji Chengbin memorialized that Dzungar bandits attacked Kuoshetu pass; Regional Commander Fan Ting defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Ji Chengbin reported Dzungar attack on Kuoshetu pass and Fan Ting's victory.

sentences.zh: 予樊廷世職，銀一萬兩。

translations.literal: Fan Ting was granted a hereditary office and ten thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ting received a hereditary office and ten thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 其張朝佐等並予世職，賞銀有差。

translations.literal: Zhang Chaozuo and others were also granted hereditary offices and silver in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chaozuo and others also received hereditary offices and graded silver rewards.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、山西、湖南、貴州等省十八州縣衛災賦。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for eighteen prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shanxi, Hunan, Guizhou, and other provinces was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for eighteen disaster districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shanxi, Hunan, Guizhou, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 又免直隸、江南、山東、河南漕糧各有差。

translations.literal: Grain transport tax for Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, and Henan was also remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Grain transport tax was also remitted in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南、南掌入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Annan, and Nan Zhang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Annan, and Nan Zhang paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年辛亥春正月庚寅，詔撥揚州鹽義倉積穀二十萬石，加賑上年邳、宿被水災民。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, day gengyin: two hundred thousand shi of relief grain from Yangzhou Salt Charity Granary were ordered disbursed to add relief for last year's flood victims in Pi and Su.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, two hundred thousand shi from Yangzhou Salt Charity Granary were sent to relieve last year's flood victims in Pi and Su.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，愉郡王胤烜薨，諡曰恪，子弘慶襲郡王。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: Prince Yu Yin Xuan died, posthumous title Ke; his son Hong Qing inherited as commandery prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Prince Yu Yin Xuan died with posthumous name Ke; his son Hong Qing inherited.

sentences.zh: 撥通倉米十五萬石，奉天米二十萬石，採買米五萬石，運往山東備賑。

translations.literal: Fifteen thousand shi of Tongzhou grain, two hundred thousand shi of Fengtian grain, and fifty thousand shi of purchased grain were allocated and transported to Shandong for relief stores.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhou, Fengtian, and purchased grain totaling 265,000 shi were sent to Shandong for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命常賚為鎮安將軍，率甘、涼兵駐安西。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Chang Ben was ordered made Zhen'an general, leading Gansu and Liangzhou troops to garrison Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Chang Ben became Zhen'an general and led Gansu and Liangzhou troops to Anxi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以田文鏡年老多病，命侍郎王國棟前往河南賑濟被水災民。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, because Tian Wenjing was old and ill, Vice Minister Wang Guodong was ordered to proceed to Henan to relieve flood victims.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Wang Guodong was sent to Henan to relieve floods because Tian Wenjing was old and ill.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，專設四川總督，以黃廷桂補授。

translations.literal: On day renxu, a Sichuan governor-generalship was specially established; Huang Tinggui was appointed to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, a Sichuan governor-general was established and Huang Tinggui appointed.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，以三泰為禮部尚書，鄂爾奇為左都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiyou: Santai was made Minister of Rites, and E'erqi Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Santai became Minister of Rites and E'erqi Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命揀選八旗家人二千，以伊禮布統之，為西路副將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, two thousand Banner retainers were ordered selected under Yilibu's command as western route vice general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, two thousand Banner retainers under Yilibu were made western route vice general.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，命史貽直、杭奕祿前往陝西宣諭化導。
