translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengzi: Shi Yizhi and Hang Yilu were ordered to proceed to Shaanxi to proclaim and guide.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Shi Yizhi and Hang Yilu were sent to Shaanxi to proclaim and guide.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，鄂彌達奏瓊山、儋州生黎內附。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, E'ermida memorialized that raw Li of Qiongshan and Danzhou submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, E'ermida reported submission of raw Li in Qiongshan and Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，以石雲倬為西路副將軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiazi: Shi Yunzhuo was made western route vice general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Shi Yunzhuo became western route vice general.

sentences.zh: 命趙之垣、馬龍督運西路糧饟。

translations.literal: Zhao Zhiyuan and Ma Long were ordered to supervise transport of western route provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zhiyuan and Ma Long were ordered to supervise western route grain transport.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，傅爾丹奏準噶爾入寇扎克賽河，率兵迎擊。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu: Fu Erdan memorialized that the Dzungars invaded the Zha'ersai River; he led troops to meet the attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Fu Erdan reported a Dzungar invasion of the Zha'ersai River and led troops to meet it.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，岳鍾琪奏準噶爾犯吐魯番，率兵赴援，賊遁，留兵屯戍。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Yue Zhongqi memorialized that the Dzungars invaded Turfan; he led troops to the rescue; the bandits fled; troops were left garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Yue Zhongqi drove off Dzungar invaders of Turfan and left a garrison.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上祈雨，是日，雨。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor prayed for rain; that day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor prayed for rain and rain fell the same day.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，召鄂爾泰來京。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingmao: E'ertai was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingmao day, E'ertai was summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以高其倬為雲貴總督，尹繼善為兩江總督。

translations.literal: Gao Qizhuo was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general, and Yin Jishan governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qizhuo became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general and Yin Jishan Jiangnan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己巳，黃廷桂奏瞻對番賊作亂，遣兵剿平之。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Huang Tinggui memorialized that Zhandui Tibetan bandits rebelled; troops were dispatched and the disturbance was suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Huang Tinggui suppressed a Zhandui Tibetan revolt.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，傅爾丹奏官兵進擊準噶爾不利，退至科布多。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Fu Erdan memorialized that the government troops' advance against the Dzungars was unfavorable; they retreated to Khobdo.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Fu Erdan reported an unsuccessful advance against the Dzungars and retreat to Khobdo.

sentences.zh: 是役也，輕進中伏，傅爾丹棄大軍先退，至於大敗。

translations.literal: In this campaign, advancing rashly they fell into an ambush; Furdan abandoned the main army and retreated first, leading to a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Furdan's rash advance into an ambush and early retreat brought a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 副將軍查弼納、公巴賽、參贊公達福等均死之。

translations.literal: Deputy commander Zhabina, Gongbasai, and staff officer Gong Dafu all died in the action.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy generals Zhabina and Gongbasai and staff officer Gong Dafu were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命馬爾賽為撫遠大將軍，敕錫保固守察罕瘦爾。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Maiser was appointed Pacification Commissioner-in-chief; an edict ordered Xibao to hold Chahan Sho'or firmly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Maiser became Pacification Commissioner-in-chief and Xibao was ordered to defend Chahan Sho'or.

sentences.zh: 岳鍾琪奏督兵進烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: Yue Zhongqi memorialized that he was leading troops toward Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi reported marching on Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，以鄂彌達為青州將軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jihai: Emida was made Qingzhou commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jihai day, Emida became Qingzhou commander.

sentences.zh: 丙午，移科布多兵駐察罕瘦爾。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, troops at Kobdo were moved to garrison Chahan Sho'or.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Kobdo forces were shifted to Chahan Sho'or.

sentences.zh: 己酉，晉封錫保為順承親王。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Xibao was advanced in rank to Prince Shuncheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Xibao was promoted to Prince Shuncheng.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，岳鍾琪奏兵至納鄰河，距烏魯木齊二日程，探知賊遁，大兵即旋。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Yue Zhongqi memorialized that the army reached Nalin River, two days' march from Urumqi; scouts found the rebels had fled, and the main force at once withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Yue Zhongqi reported reaching Nalin River near Urumqi, learning the enemy had fled, and turning back.

sentences.zh: 命從優議敘。

translations.literal: An order was issued to reward them with preferential commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered preferential rewards.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，命康親王崇安前往軍營，給備裝銀萬兩。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yihai: Prince Chong'an was ordered to proceed to the army camp and was granted ten thousand taels of silver for outfitting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Prince Chong'an was sent to camp with ten thousand taels for expenses.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以劉於義為直隸總督，沈廷玉為直隸河道總督，朱藻為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Liu Yuyi was made governor-general of Zhili, Shen Tingyu governor-general of the Zhili waterways, and Zhu Zao governor-general of the Hedong waterways.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Liu Yuyi, Shen Tingyu, and Zhu Zao received new waterway and Zhili posts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇后那拉氏崩，冊諡曰孝敬皇后。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Empress Nara died; she was given the posthumous title Xiaojing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Empress Nara died and received the posthumous name Xiaojing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，錢以塏乞休，以魏廷珍為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: Qian Yikai asked to retire; Wei Tingzhen was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Qian Yikai retired and Wei Tingzhen became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾入寇克魯倫，侵掠游牧，親王丹津多爾濟、額駙郡王策凌合兵擊之，擒斬無算。

translations.literal: The Dzungars invaded the Kerulen, plundering nomadic camps; Princes Danjin Duo'erji and imperial son-in-law Prince Celeng joined forces to attack them and killed and captured without number.
translations.idiomatic: Dzungar raiders on the Kerulen were beaten by Princes Danjin Duo'erji and Celeng with heavy enemy losses.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，各賜銀萬兩，晉策凌為親王。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised them; each was granted ten thousand taels of silver, and Celeng was advanced to prince.
translations.idiomatic: Each received ten thousand taels of silver and Celeng was made a prince.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，命順承親王錫保為靖邊大將軍，降傅爾丹為振武將軍，降馬爾賽為綏遠將軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guihai: Prince Shuncheng Xibao was appointed Pacification Commissioner-in-chief for the frontier; Furdan was reduced to Zhenwu General and Maiser to Suiyuan General.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Xibao became frontier commander while Furdan and Maiser were demoted.

sentences.zh: 命康親王崇安攝撫遠大將軍。

translations.literal: Prince Chong'an was ordered to act as Pacification Commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chong'an was named acting Pacification Commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以史貽直為兵部尚書，彭維新為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day chou: Shi Yizhi was made Minister of War and Peng Weixin Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On chou day, Shi Yizhi became Minister of War and Peng Weixin Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day of the month on day gengyin: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己酉，聖祖實錄、聖訓告成。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Veritable Records and Sacred Instructions of the Kangxi Emperor were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the Kangxi Veritable Records and Sacred Instructions were finished.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以馬士傑署廣州將軍，准泰署福州將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Ma Shijie was appointed acting Guangzhou commander and Zhuntai acting Fuzhou commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Ma Shijie and Zhuntai received acting regional commands.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the collective autumn sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the autumn temple sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、河南、福建、陝西、湖南、廣西、甘肅等省九十三州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for ninety-three prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangnan, Henan, Fujian, Shaanxi, Hunan, Guangxi, Gansu, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in ninety-three districts across several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十年壬寅春正月癸亥，孟春享太廟，皇四子弘曆行禮。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, day guihai: at the first-spring sacrifice to the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the fourth imperial son Hongli performed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on guihai day in the first month, Prince Hongli led the spring temple sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命鄂爾泰為大學士。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Ortai was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Ortai became Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以軍前統領達爾濟為建勛將軍，駐兵白格爾。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Da'erji, commander at the front, was made Jianxun General and stationed troops at Baige'er.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, front commander Da'erji became Jianxun General at Baige'er.

sentences.zh: 二月，以王朝恩為直隸河道總督，魏廷珍為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Second month: Wang Chao'en was made governor-general of the Zhili waterways, and Wei Tingzhen transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Wang Chao'en and Wei Tingzhen received waterway and transport posts.

sentences.zh: 己亥，封鄂爾泰一等伯，世襲。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Ortai was enfeoffed as a first-class baron with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Ortai received a hereditary first-class barony.

sentences.zh: 庚子，岳鍾琪奏準噶爾犯哈密，遣總兵曹勷往援，敗之，賊由無克克嶺遁。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yue Zhongqi memorialized that the Dzungars attacked Hami; Regional Commander Cao Peng was sent to aid, defeated them, and the rebels fled by the Wukeke Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yue Zhongqi reported a Dzungar attack on Hami repulsed by Cao Peng as the enemy fled.

sentences.zh: 副將軍石雲倬坐不遮擊，逮問。

translations.literal: Deputy commander Shi Yunzhuo was charged with failing to intercept and was arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yunzhuo was arrested for letting the enemy escape.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以張廣泗為西路副將軍，劉世明參軍事。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Zhang Guangsi was made western-route deputy commander and Liu Shiming joined the staff.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Zhang Guangsi and Liu Shiming received western-route commands.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，大學士等疏劾岳鍾琪奏報不實，情詞互異。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: the Grand Secretaries and others jointly impeached Yue Zhongqi for false reporting and mutually contradictory statements.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Grand Secretaries impeached Yue Zhongqi for inconsistent reports.

sentences.zh: 下部嚴議。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the ministries for strict deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries were ordered to investigate strictly.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，置貴州古州鎮、清江鎮總兵各一員。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinmao: a regional commander was established at each of Guzhou and Qingjiang in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Guizhou received new commanders at Guzhou and Qingjiang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以海壽為戶部尚書，性桂為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Hai Shou was made Minister of Revenue and Xinggui Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Hai Shou and Xinggui became revenue and punishment ministers.

sentences.zh: 降三等公岳鍾琪為三等侯，仍護大將軍。

translations.literal: Third-rank Duke Yue Zhongqi was reduced to third-rank marquis but still acted as commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi was demoted from duke to marquis while keeping command.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以張大有為禮部尚書，范時繹為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Zhang Dayou was made Minister of Rites and Fan Shiyi Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Zhang Dayou and Fan Shiyi received ministry posts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔修雲南嵩明州、尋甸州水利。

translations.literal: On day yimao, an edict ordered waterworks repaired in Songming and Xundian prefectures of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Yunnan irrigation works at Songming and Xundian were ordered repaired.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，以武格為揚武將軍，劉世明副之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen: Wuge was made Yangwu General with Liu Shiming as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Wuge became Yangwu General with Liu Shiming as deputy.

sentences.zh: 閏五月甲辰，恆親王胤祺薨，諡曰溫，子弘晊襲恆親王。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, day jiachen: Prince Heng Yinqi died; posthumous title Wen; his son Hongzhi inherited Prince Heng.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, Prince Heng Yinqi died with posthumous name Wen; Hongzhi succeeded as Prince Heng.

sentences.zh: 原誠親王胤祉卒於景山禁所，賜銀五千兩，照郡王例殯葬。

translations.literal: Former Prince Cheng Yinqi died in confinement at Jingshan; five thousand taels of silver were granted and he was buried by the standards of a commandery prince.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Cheng Yinqi died under house arrest at Jingshan and received commandery-prince burial honors.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書勵廷儀卒。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Li Tingyi died.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Li Tingyi died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，台灣北路西番滋事，官兵討平之。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, western barbarians in northern Taiwan caused trouble; government troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, troops pacified western barbarian unrest in northern Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以李衛署刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Li Wei was appointed acting Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Li Wei became acting Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰，以莽鵠立為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingchen: Mang Holi was made commander-in-chief of the Han Banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Mang Holi became Han Banner commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬申，高其倬奏雲南思茅土夷勾結元江夷人寇普洱郡城，遣總兵董芳率兵剿之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Gao Qizhuo memorialized that Simao native chiefs in Yunnan had joined Yuanjiang tribesmen in attacking Pu'er prefectural city; Regional Commander Dong Fang was sent with troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Gao Qizhuo reported a Yunnan uprising and sent Dong Fang to suppress it.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，辦理軍機大臣議奏恤贈戰歿喀爾喀台吉策勒克輔國公，其子密什克襲。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Grand Councilors deliberated and memorialized posthumous honors for the fallen Khalkha taiji Celerke, enfeoffed as Defender Duke of the State; his son Mishike succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Grand Council granted honors to the fallen Khalkha taiji Celerke and his son Mishike.

sentences.zh: 軍機大臣之設始於此。

translations.literal: The establishment of Grand Councilors dates from this.
translations.idiomatic: The office of Grand Councilor began here.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙戌，馬喇免，以武格為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingxu: Mala was dismissed and Wuge was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Mala was dismissed and Wuge became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，山東鉅野牛產瑞麟。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, at Juye in Shandong a cow gave birth to an auspicious qilin.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, a cow at Juye in Shandong bore a reputed qilin.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賜顧八代子孫銀一萬兩。

translations.literal: On day jichou, ten thousand taels of silver were granted to the descendants of Gu Badai.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Gu Badai's descendants received ten thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命鄂爾泰經略軍務。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Ortai was ordered to take overall direction of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Ortai was placed in charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 召岳鍾琪來京。

translations.literal: Yue Zhongqi was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以劉於義為陝西總督，李衛為直隸總督。

translations.literal: Liu Yuyi was made governor-general of Shaanxi and Li Wei governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuyi became Shaanxi governor-general and Li Wei Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，準噶爾入犯烏孫珠爾，傅爾丹迎擊失利，下大將軍錫保覈敗狀以聞。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Dzungars invaded Wusun Zhu'er; Furdan met them in battle but was defeated; Commander-in-chief Xibao was ordered to verify the defeat and report.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Furdan was beaten repelling a Dzungar attack at Wusun Zhu'er and Xibao was told to report.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，大學士蔣廷錫卒。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Grand Secretary Jiang Yingsi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Grand Secretary Jiang Yingsi died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以福敏協理大學士，唐執玉兼理刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Fumin was ordered to assist the Grand Secretariat and Tang Zhiyu to act concurrently as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Fumin joined the Grand Secretariat and Tang Zhiyu acted as punishment minister.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，復恭親王之子海善貝勒原銜。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingchen: Prince Gong's son Haishan was restored to his original beile rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Haishan, son of Prince Gong, regained his beile title.

sentences.zh: 庚午，西藏邊外巴爾布國雅木布、葉楞、庫庫穆三汗遣使進貢，優敕答之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the three khans of Balu beyond Tibet's borders—Yamubu, Yeleng, and Kukumu—sent envoys with tribute; a gracious edict replied to them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, three Balu khans beyond Tibet sent tribute and received an imperial reply.

sentences.zh: 壬申，北路副將軍親王丹津多爾濟、額駙親王策凌奏追擊准夷至額爾得尼招，殺賊萬餘，賊向推河遁去。

translations.literal: On day renshen, northern-route deputy commanders Prince Danjin Duo'erji and imperial son-in-law Prince Celeng memorialized that in pursuing the Dzungars to Erdeni Zhao they killed more than ten thousand rebels before the enemy fled toward the Tui River.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Danjin Duo'erji and Celeng reported killing over ten thousand Dzungars at Erdeni Zhao.

sentences.zh: 甲申，撥帑銀二百萬兩解赴北路軍前備賞。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, two million taels from the treasury were sent to the northern army for rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, two million taels were allocated for northern-front rewards.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉朔，論擊准夷功，加丹津多爾濟智勇名號，加策凌超勇名號，封其子車布登扎布為輔國公，餘升授有差。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day of the month on day yiyou: for merit against the Dzungars, Danjin Duo'erji was given the honorific Zhiyong and Celeng Chaoyong; Celeng's son Kebudeng Zhabu was enfeoffed Defender Duke of the State; others were promoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth-month new moon, victors over the Dzungars received titles and promotions.

sentences.zh: 以馬爾賽縱賊失機，褫爵職處斬。

translations.literal: Maiser was stripped of rank and office and executed for letting the enemy escape and missing his chance.
translations.idiomatic: Maiser was executed for allowing the Dzungars to escape.

sentences.zh: 己酉，削傅爾丹爵職。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Furdan was stripped of rank and office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Furdan lost his title and post.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，停本年決囚。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renxu: executions of condemned prisoners for the year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, autumn executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 削岳鍾琪爵職，逮京交兵部拘禁。

translations.literal: Yue Zhongqi was stripped of rank and office, brought to the capital, and confined by the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi was disgraced, arrested, and held by the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，以常德為靖邊左副將軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingxu: Changde was made left deputy frontier commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Changde became left deputy frontier commander.

sentences.zh: 乙未，封吐魯番額敏和卓為輔國公。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Emin Hezhuo of Turfan was enfeoffed Defender Duke of the State.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Turfan's Emin Hezhuo became Defender Duke of the State.

sentences.zh: 賜七世同居湖南沅江縣生員譙衿御書匾額。

translations.literal: An imperial calligraphic plaque was granted to licentiate Qiao Jin of Yuanjiang county, Hunan, whose family had lived together for seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: A seven-generation household in Yuanjiang, Hunan, received an imperial plaque.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，賜恤北路陣亡諸臣查弼納、馬爾薩、海蘭、達福等有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yimao: posthumous honors of varying degrees were granted to northern-route officers fallen in battle, including Zhabina, Ma'ersa, Hailan, and Dafu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, fallen northern commanders including Zhabina received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 侍郎孫嘉淦有罪論死，命在銀庫處行走。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Sun Jiagan, guilty of a capital offense, was sentenced to death but ordered to serve in the silver vault.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jiagan, though condemned to death, was put to work in the silver vault.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，治呂留良罪，與呂葆中、嚴鴻逵俱戮屍，斬呂毅中、沈在寬，其孫發邊遠為奴，朱羽采等釋放。

translations.literal: On day chou: the cases of Lü Liuliang, Lü Baozhong, and Yan Hongkui were judged; their corpses were dismembered, Lü Yizhong and Shen Zaikuan were beheaded, their grandsons were sent to the frontier as slaves, and Zhu Yucai and others were released.
translations.idiomatic: On chou day, the Lü Liuliang treason case ended in executions and enslavement while some co-defendants were freed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，武格以造言撤兵，逮問。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Wuge was arrested for spreading false talk to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Wuge was arrested for rumor-mongering about withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the collective autumn sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the autumn temple sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、山東、湖南等省七十五州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax for seventy-five prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Hunan, and other provinces was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tax relief was granted for disaster areas in seventy-five districts.

sentences.zh: 丁戶二千五百四十一萬二千二百八十九，永不加賦後滋生人丁九十三萬六千四百八十六。

translations.literal: Registered ding households numbered 25,412,289; additional persons registered after the perpetual no-increase policy numbered 936,486.
translations.idiomatic: Registers listed 25.4 million ding households and 936,486 additional persons under the no-increase rule.

sentences.zh: 田地八十九萬四百十六頃四十畝，徵銀二千九百八十七萬二千三百三十二兩六錢。

translations.literal: Cultivated land totaled 890,416 qing and 40 mou; collected silver amounted to 29,872,332 taels and 6 cash.
translations.idiomatic: Land registers showed 890,416 qing and tax silver of 29.87 million taels.

sentences.zh: 茶三十四萬二千三百五十一引。

translations.literal: Tea totaled 342,351 licenses.
translations.idiomatic: Tea licenses numbered 342,351.

sentences.zh: 鹽課銀三百九十八萬八千八百五十一兩。

translations.literal: Salt tax silver amounted to 3,988,851 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Salt tax revenue was 3.99 million taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 鑄錢六萬八千四百三十六萬二千有奇。

translations.literal: Coins minted totaled more than 684,363,200 strings.
translations.idiomatic: Coinage exceeded 684 million strings.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、巴爾布國入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Balu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Balu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一年癸丑春正月戊子，命海望、李衛察勘浙江海塘。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, day wuzi: Haiwang and Li Wei were ordered to survey the Zhejiang seawall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on wuzi day in the first month, Haiwang and Li Wei were sent to inspect the Zhejiang coast.

sentences.zh: 修范公堤。

translations.literal: The Fan Gong embankment was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The Fan Gong dike was repaired.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，頒直省書院膏火銀各千兩。

translations.literal: On day renchen, stipends of one thousand taels each were issued to provincial academies for lamp oil.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, each provincial academy received one thousand taels for stipends.

sentences.zh: 以高其倬為兩江總督，尹繼善為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Gao Qizhuo was made governor-general of Liangjiang and Yin Jishan governor-general of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qizhuo became Liangjiang governor-general and Yin Jishan Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命鄂爾泰巡閱北路軍務。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Ortai was ordered to inspect northern-route military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Ortai was sent to review the northern armies.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor visited the tombs.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，上見沿道安設水缸，蓄水灑道。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi: the Emperor saw water jars set along the route storing water to sprinkle the road.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi day, the Emperor noticed jars of water set out to wet the road.

sentences.zh: 上諭之曰：「蹕路所經，雖有微塵何礙。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed them, saying: "Along the imperial progress route, though there be a little dust, what harm is there?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said a little dust along the route did not matter.

sentences.zh: 地方官當以牧養生民為重。

translations.literal: Local officials should regard nourishing the people as paramount.
translations.idiomatic: Officials should put the people's welfare first.

sentences.zh: 若移奉上之心以撫百姓，豈不善乎？

translations.literal: If you turned the mind devoted to serving Us toward comforting the common people, would that not be better?"
translations.idiomatic: Devoting the same zeal to the people as to the throne would be better."

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，上還京。

translations.literal: " On day guichou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以保明、查爾泰、伊勒慎俱為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Baoming, Cha'ertai, and Yilezhen were all made Manchu commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Baoming, Cha'ertai, and Yilezhen became Manchu commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 封皇二十四弟胤祕為諴親王，皇四子弘曆為寶親王，皇五子弘晝為和親王。

translations.literal: The twenty-fourth imperial brother Yinmi was enfeoffed Prince Cheng, the fourth son Hongli Prince Bao, and the fifth son Hongzhou Prince He.
translations.idiomatic: Yinmi became Prince Cheng, Hongli Prince Bao, and Hongzhou Prince He.

sentences.zh: 貝勒弘春晉封泰郡王。

translations.literal: Beile Hongchun was advanced to Prince Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Beile Hongchun was made Prince Tai.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命彭維新協辦內閣。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Peng Weixin was ordered to assist in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Peng Weixin joined the Grand Secretariat staff.

sentences.zh: 以吳士玉為禮部尚書，涂天相為左都御史。

translations.literal: Wu Shiyu was made Minister of Rites and Tu Tianxiang Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shiyu became Minister of Rites and Tu Tianxiang Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，特賜任啟運翰林，在阿哥書房行走。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi: Ren Qiyun was specially granted Hanlin status to serve in the princes' study.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Ren Qiyun received special Hanlin appointment in the princes' school.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賜陳倓等三百二十八人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Chen Tan and three hundred twenty-eight others were granted jinshi and other ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Chen Tan and 328 others received jinshi degrees with graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以嵇曾筠為大學士，仍管河督。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Ji Zengyun was made Grand Secretary while continuing as director-general of waterways.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Ji Zengyun became Grand Secretary and kept charge of the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 以劉於義為吏部尚書，涂天相為刑部尚書，張照為左都御史。

translations.literal: Liu Yuyi was made Minister of Personnel, Tu Tianxiang Minister of Justice, and Zhang Zhao Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuyi, Tu Tianxiang, and Zhang Zhao received new ministerial posts.

sentences.zh: 己未，徵舉博學鴻詞。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, an imperial call was issued to recommend men of broad learning and eminent literary talent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the court summoned candidates for the erudite-literary examination.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，高其倬奏普思苗人刁興國叛，討平之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiashen: Gao Qizhuo memorialized that Pu'en Miao leader Diao Xingguo had rebelled; he was suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Gao Qizhuo reported suppression of a Pu'en Miao revolt led by Diao Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 命編修張若靄，庶吉士鄂容安、鄂倫俱在辦理軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Compiler Zhang Ruogai and Hanlin expectants E Rong'an and E Lun were ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ruogai, E Rong'an, and E Lun were assigned to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命額駙策凌為靖邊左副將軍，常德副之，塔爾岱為靖邊右副將軍，永福副之，同戍科布多。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Imperial Son-in-law Celeng was made Left Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier, Changde as his deputy; Tarda'e Right Deputy General, Yongfu as his deputy; together they garrisoned Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Celeng and Tarda'e became left and right deputy frontier generals at Kobdo, with Changde and Yongfu as deputies.

sentences.zh: 續修會典成。

translations.literal: The continued revision of the Collected Statutes was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The revised Collected Statutes were completed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，黑龍江將軍杜賚奏海島特門、奇圖山等處綽敏六姓內附，歲貢貂皮。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Heilongjiang general Du Zai memorialized that six Chuo Min clans of Temen, Qitu Hill, and other sea islands had submitted, paying tribute of sable pelts annually.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, six clans on Heilongjiang sea islands submitted and paid annual sable tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，誅前提督紀成斌。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, former provincial commander Ji Chengabin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, former commander Ji Chengabin was executed.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，蘇祿國王臣毋漢未毋拉律林奏伊遠祖東王於明永樂年間來朝，歸至山東德州病歿。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: the king of Sulu, Muhammad Maulana, memorialized that his distant ancestor the Eastern King came to court in the Yongle reign of Ming and died of illness at Dezhou, Shandong, on the return journey.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Sulu king reported that his Ming-era ancestor the Eastern King died at Dezhou, Shandong, after an embassy.

sentences.zh: 長子歸國嗣王，次子安都祿，三子溫哈喇留守墳墓。

translations.literal: His eldest son returned home to succeed as king; the second son Andulu and the third son Wenkhala remained to guard the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The eldest son succeeded at home; Andulu and Wenkhala stayed to guard the tomb.

sentences.zh: 其子孫分為安、溫二姓，歲領額設祭祀銀八兩，請以其後裔為奉祀生。

translations.literal: Their descendants divided into the An and Wen surnames, receiving eight taels of silver yearly for sacrifices; they asked that their descendants be made ritual attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of the An and Wen lines received eight taels yearly for rites and sought appointment as ritual attendants.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，哈元生奏討平九股逆苗。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Ha Yuansheng memorialized that the nine-braid rebellious Miao had been suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Ha Yuansheng reported suppression of nine-braid Miao rebels.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，大學士陳元龍以年逾八旬乞休，加太子太傅致仕。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yiyou: Grand Secretary Chen Yuanlong, over eighty years old, asked to retire; he was made Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired with honor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Grand Secretary Chen Yuanlong, over eighty, retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 李徽以越職言事褫職。

translations.literal: Li Hui was stripped of office for speaking on matters beyond his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hui lost his post for overstepping in memorializing.

sentences.zh: 裁湖南觀風整俗使。

translations.literal: The Hunan commissioner for observing customs and reforming popular practices was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan customs-reform commissioner post was cut.

sentences.zh: 戊子，順承親王錫保削爵，子熙良仍襲郡王。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Prince Shuncheng Xibao was stripped of his noble rank; his son Xiliang still inherited the commandery prince title.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shuncheng Xibao lost his rank; his son Xiliang kept the commandery prince title.

sentences.zh: 以平郡王福彭為定邊大將軍。

translations.literal: Prince Ping Fupeng was made great general for securing the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ping Fupeng became frontier great general.

sentences.zh: 降親王丹津多爾濟為郡王，撤去勇號。

translations.literal: Prince Danjin Dorji was demoted from prince to commandery prince and his brave-title removed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Danjin Dorji was demoted to commandery prince and lost his honorary epithet.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，以顧琮為直隸河道總督，趙弘恩為兩江總督，高其倬為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingmao: Gu Cong was made Zhili director-general of waterways; Zhao Hong'en Two-Jiangs governor-general; Gao Qizhuo Jiangsu provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Gu Cong, Zhao Hong'en, and Gao Qizhuo received river and provincial posts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置順天府四路捕盜同知。

translations.literal: On day jisi, four route co-magistrates for catching bandits were established in Shuntian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, four Shuntian bandit-catching co-magistrates were created.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，鄂爾奇革職查訊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinchou: E'erqi was dismissed from office and placed under investigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, E'erqi was dismissed pending investigation.

sentences.zh: 以慶復為戶部尚書，鄂長署步軍統領。

translations.literal: Qing Fu was made Minister of Revenue; E Chang acted as commandant of the Metropolitan Banners.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Fu became Minister of Revenue; E Chang acted as metropolitan banner commandant.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，以扣婁為蒙古都統，忠達公馬禮善為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou: Kou Lou was made Mongol banner commander-in-chief; Duke Zhongda Ma Lishan Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Kou Lou became Mongol commander-in-chief and Ma Lishan Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，命果毅公訥親在辦理軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiachen: Duke Guoyi Neqin was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Duke Guoyi Neqin was assigned to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，詔曰：「前鄂彌達條奏台灣建城。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu, an edict said: "Earlier E'mida memorialized on building walled cities in Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, an edict cited earlier proposals to fortify Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 郝玉麟奏稱台灣茨竹，栽植可以成城。

translations.literal: Hao Yulin memorialized that Taiwan thorn bamboo, planted densely, could form a wall.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yulin said thorn bamboo could serve as defensive walls.

sentences.zh: 台灣變亂，率自內生。

translations.literal: Taiwan disturbances generally arise from within.
translations.idiomatic: The edict said Taiwan revolts usually sprang from internal causes.

sentences.zh: 賊匪無城可踞，乃易蕩平。

translations.literal: Without walled cities for bandits to hold, they are easily suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: Without cities, rebels were easier to rout.

sentences.zh: 惟鹿耳門為台郡門戶，於此建築砲台，足資備御。

translations.literal: Only at Lukang is the gateway to the prefectural seat; building batteries there suffices for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Lukang batteries were ordered for the prefectural gateway.

sentences.zh: 栽植茨竹，相為籓籬。

translations.literal: Planting thorn bamboo can serve as an outer hedge.
translations.idiomatic: Thorn bamboo hedges were approved where useful.

sentences.zh: 其淡水等處砲台，並應建造，以時增修。

translations.literal: Batteries at Tamsui and other places should also be built and repaired in season."
translations.idiomatic: Forts at Tamsui and elsewhere were to be built and maintained."

sentences.zh: 」己未，以史貽直為戶部尚書，張照為刑部尚書，徐本為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Shi Yizhi was made Minister of Revenue, Zhang Zhao Minister of Justice, and Xu Ben Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Shi Yizhi, Zhang Zhao, and Xu Ben received ministerial posts.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以高斌為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Gao Bin was made Jiangnan director-general of waterways.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Gao Bin became Jiangnan river director-general.

sentences.zh: 丙子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, joint seasonal sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the seasonal temple sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江蘇、安徽、江西、山東等省二十九州縣衛災賦，又免江蘇鹽場二十五引鹽課各有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster land tax was remitted for twenty-nine prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, Shandong, and other provinces; salt-field tax was also remitted in Jiangsu for twenty-five yin of salt quota to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster tax relief was granted across several provinces and Jiangsu salt levies were reduced.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南、蘇祿入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Annam, and Sulu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Annam, and Sulu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年甲寅春正月辛丑，平郡王福彭進馬五百匹，解軍備用。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, jiazi year, spring, first month, day xinchou: Prince Ping Fupeng presented five hundred horses to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Prince Ping Fupeng presented five hundred horses for the army.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，侍郎查克旦辦理車臣汗部落諸務得宜，加尚書銜，賜銀五千兩，入官房地人口給還。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Vice Minister Chakedan, having handled affairs of the Tsetsen Khan tribes well, was given the ministerial rank, granted five thousand taels of silver, and his confiscated estates, land, and household members were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Chakedan received ministerial rank, silver, and restoration of confiscated property.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day guichou: the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 己未，晉封貝子胤祜為貝勒。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Imperial Clansman Yinhu was promoted from beizi to beile.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Yinhu was promoted from beizi to beile.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命侍讀春山、給事中李學裕冊封安南國王。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Reader Chunshan and Censor Li Xueyu were ordered to invest the king of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Chunshan and Li Xueyu were sent to invest the Annam king.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命額駙策凌總理前敵軍務。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Imperial Son-in-law Celeng was ordered to take overall charge of front-line military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Celeng took overall charge of frontier operations.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，元展成奏坡東、坡西苗寨一百六十內附。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Yuan Zhancheng memorialized that one hundred sixty stockades east and west of the slopes had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Yuan Zhancheng reported 160 Miao stockades had submitted.

sentences.zh: 旌廣東興寧縣老民幸登運年一百二歲，其子五人，各七八十歲，一門眉壽，加賜上用緞一匹。

translations.literal: Recognition was granted to Xingning county old man Xing Dengyun, one hundred two years old, and five sons each seventy or eighty, long-lived in one family; an additional bolt of imperial satin was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: A 102-year-old Guangdong patriarch and his five elderly sons received an imperial satin gift.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，工部尚書范時繹免。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: Minister of Works Fan Shiyi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Works Minister Fan Shiyi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，河南學政俞鴻圖以婪贓處斬，其父侍郎俞兆晟褫職。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Henan education intendant Yu Hongtu was executed for extortion; his father Vice Minister Yu Zhaosheng was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Yu Hongtu was executed for graft and his father Yu Zhaosheng dismissed.

sentences.zh: 尹繼善奏剿平普思叛苗，招撫投誠人眾。

translations.literal: Yin Jishan memorialized that Pu'en rebel Miao had been suppressed and those who surrendered were received.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jishan reported Pu'en rebels suppressed and surrenders accepted.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「凡事懈於垂成，忽於既定。

translations.literal: An edict received: "In all affairs one is lax near completion and careless after things are settled.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor warned against slackness near victory.

sentences.zh: 勉之。

translations.literal: Strive on."
translations.idiomatic: He urged continued effort."

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，湖廣容美土司田民如有罪革退，改土歸流。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingwei: Rongmei native prefect Tian Minru was guilty and removed; the territory was converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Rongmei chieftain Tian Minru was deposed and the district garrisoned with regular officials.

sentences.zh: 康親王崇安薨，以伊叔巴爾圖襲爵，封其子永恩為貝勒。

translations.literal: Prince Kang Chong'an died; his uncle Barutu inherited the title; his son Yong'en was enfeoffed as beile.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Kang Chong'an died; Barutu succeeded and Yong'en was made beile.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禁廣東象牙席，並禁民間購用。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Guangdong ivory sleeping mats were banned, and private purchase was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Guangdong ivory mats were banned for official and private use.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，施南宣撫司改設流官。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jimao: the Shinan pacification commissioner post was replaced with a regular official.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Shinan was converted to regular administration.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以李禧為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Li Xi was made Han banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Li Xi became Han commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以準噶爾使來，停止進兵。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, because Dzungar envoys had come, the advance of troops was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, troop advance halted when Dzungar envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命內務府總管來保前赴車臣汗部，協同查克旦辦事。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Internal Affairs commissioner Laibao was ordered to proceed to the Tsetsen Khan department to handle affairs jointly with Chakedan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Laibao was sent to the Tsetsen Khan department with Chakedan.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，湖廣忠峝等十五土司改設流官。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei: fifteen native offices including Zhongdong in Huguang were replaced with regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, fifteen Huguang native offices were converted to regular rule.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，命果親王胤禮經理達賴喇嘛駐藏，並至直隸、山西、陝西、四川閱兵。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: Prince Guo Yinli was ordered to manage affairs at the Dalai Lama's residence in Tibet and to review troops in Zhili, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Prince Guo Yinli was sent to Tibet and to review troops in several provinces.

sentences.zh: 詔西北二路用兵年久，或乘此兵力直進賊境，或遣使往彼諭以利害，廷臣集議以聞。

translations.literal: An edict said that on the northwestern two routes troops had been employed for many years: either advance directly into enemy territory with present strength, or dispatch envoys to explain pros and cons; court ministers were to deliberate jointly and report.
translations.idiomatic: The court was ordered to debate whether to advance or send envoys on the long northwest campaign.

sentences.zh: 康親王巴爾圖等一議進兵，大學士張廷玉等一議遣使。

translations.literal: Prince Kang Bartu and others favored advance; Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu and others favored sending envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Bartu favored attack; Zhang Tingyu favored diplomacy.

sentences.zh: 上乃宣示用兵始末，從後議遣使。

translations.literal: The Emperor then set forth the whole course of the campaign from the start and followed the latter proposal to send envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor recounted the war and chose to send envoys.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，遣傅鼐、阿克敦往準噶爾宣諭。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingwu: Fu Tai and Akedun were dispatched to Dzungaria to proclaim the edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Fu Tai and Akedun were sent to Dzungaria.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，降貝子胤禕為公，泰郡王弘春降為貝子。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Beizi Yinli was demoted to duke; Prince Tai Hongchun was demoted to beizi.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Yinli and Hongchun were demoted.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，命侍郎呂耀曾、卿德福往貴州宣諭苗蠻。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: Vice Minister Lü Yaoceng and Director Defu were ordered to proclaim edicts to Miao tribes in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Lü Yaoceng and Defu were sent to Guizhou Miao.

sentences.zh: 命雲南開爐鼓鑄。

translations.literal: Yunnan was ordered to open furnaces for coin casting.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan was ordered to mint coin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，果親王胤禮疏言：「臣工條奏，宜據實敷陳，不當摭拾塞責。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: Prince Guo Yinli memorialized: "When ministers submit memorials on regulations, they should state facts fully and must not patch together perfunctory answers.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Prince Guo urged honest memorials, not perfunctory ones.

sentences.zh: 」得旨：「所言甚是，曉諭輪班條奏官知之。

translations.literal: An edict received: "What you say is very correct; inform the officials who rotate in submitting regulations."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed and told rotating memorialists to heed it."

sentences.zh: 」丁未，以鄂彌達署天津都統，阿里袞為青州將軍，傅森為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, E'mida acted as Tianjin banner commander; Aligung Qingzhou general; Fusen Hangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, E'mida, Aligung, and Fusen received military posts.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以郝玉麟為浙閩總督。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Hao Yulin was made Zhe-Fujian governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Hao Yulin became Zhe-Fujian governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以三泰、徐本俱協辦內閣事。

translations.literal: San Tai and Xu Ben were both assigned to assist Grand Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: San Tai and Xu Ben were assigned to assist the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己巳，景陵瑞芝生。

translations.literal: On day jisi, auspicious fungi grew at Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, auspicious fungi appeared at the Yongzheng mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申朔，前直郡王胤禔卒，命照貝子治喪，封其子弘昉為鎮國公。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renshen, first of the month: former Prince Zhi Yinze died; he was buried with beizi rites; his son Hongfang was enfeoffed as Defender of the State.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the eleventh month, Yinze died; Hongfang was made Defender of the State.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，敕續修皇清文穎。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, continued revision of the Imperial Qing Literary Collection was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, revision of the Imperial Qing Literary Collection was ordered.

sentences.zh: 壬午，特詔福建漳、泉二府，化其強悍，勿再聚族械鬥。

translations.literal: On day renwu, a special edict to Zhang and Quan prefectures in Fujian to reform their fierce character and cease clan armed fights.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Fujian's Zhang and Quan prefectures were told to end clan feuds.

sentences.zh: 戊子，封理密親王子弘晁為輔國公。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Prince Limi's son Hongchao was enfeoffed as Assistant State Defender.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Hongchao was made Assistant State Defender.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑朔，敕廣西仍歸廣東總督兼轄。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou, first of the month: Guangxi was again placed under the Guangdong governor-general's concurrent jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the twelfth month, Guangxi returned to Guangdong governor-general's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以魏廷珍為兵部尚書，顧琮為漕運總督，朱藻為直隸河道總督，白鍾山為河東河道總督，高斌為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Wei Tingzhen was made Minister of War; Gu Cong grain transport director-general; Zhu Zao Zhili director-general of waterways; Bai Zhongshan Hedong director-general of waterways; Gao Bin Jiangnan director-general of waterways.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Wei Tingzhen, Gu Cong, Zhu Zao, Bai Zhongshan, and Gao Bin received posts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, joint seasonal sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the seasonal temple sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、安徽等省十四州縣災賦，又直隸鹽場十四引鹽課各有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster land tax was remitted for fourteen prefectures and counties in Zhili, Anhui, and other provinces; Zhili salt-field tax was also remitted for fourteen yin of salt quota to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster tax and salt relief were granted in several provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十三年乙卯春正月己丑，以覺羅柏修為盛京將軍，那蘇圖為黑龍江將軍，赫星為寧夏將軍。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, yimao year, spring, first month, day jichou: Aisin Gioro Baixiu was made Shengjing general; Nasutu Heilongjiang general; Hexing Ningxia general.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Baixiu, Nasutu, and Hexing became frontier generals.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou: the Emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以魏廷珍為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Wei Tingzhen was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Wei Tingzhen became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor visited the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor visited the tombs.

sentences.zh: 己未，還京。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以巴泰協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Batai was assigned to assist as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Batai was assigned to assist the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，上親耕耤田。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingsi: the Emperor personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔曰：「地方編立保甲，必須俯順輿情，徐為勸導。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, an edict said: "In organizing local baojia household registers, one must comply with popular feeling and guide them gradually.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, an edict urged gradual, popular-guided baojia registration.

sentences.zh: 若過於嚴急，則善良受累矣。

translations.literal: If too harsh, the good suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Harsh enforcement would harm the innocent.

sentences.zh: 為政以得人為要，不得其人，雖良法美意，徒美觀聽，於民無濟也。

translations.literal: In governing, obtaining the right men is essential; without the right men, however fine the law, it is mere display and of no benefit to the people."
translations.idiomatic: Without capable officials, good laws availed nothing."

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，聖祖文集刊成，頒賜廷臣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yimao: the Collected Writings of the Holy Ancestor were published and bestowed on court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Kangxi's collected writings were published and given to ministers.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，停止廣東開採。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Guangdong mining was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Guangdong mining was stopped.

sentences.zh: 閏四月丁酉，準噶爾遣使臣納木喀賚表進貢。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day dingyou: the Dzungars sent envoy Namuka bearing tribute and memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, a Dzungar envoy brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 敕令定界。

translations.literal: Orders were issued to fix the border.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered a border demarcation.

sentences.zh: 己亥，建先蠶壇於北郊。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the First Silkworm Altar was built in the northern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the First Silkworm Altar was built north of the city.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，給三姓八旗兵丁餉銀。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen: pay silver for rations to banner soldiers of the Three Surnames.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wushen day, rations silver was issued to Three Surnames banner troops.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以貴州古州、台拱逆苗滋事，命哈元生為揚威將軍，統領四省官兵討之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, because rebellious Miao at Guzhou and Taigong in Guizhou caused trouble, Ha Yuansheng was appointed Yangwei General to command troops of four provinces in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Ha Yuansheng was made Yangwei General to lead four provinces' forces against Guizhou's rebellious Miao.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命果親王、皇四子、皇五子，大學士鄂爾泰、張廷玉等辦苗疆事務。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Prince Guo, the fourth and fifth imperial sons, Grand Secretaries Ortai and Zhang Tingyu, and others were ordered to handle Miao frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Prince Guo, the fourth and fifth sons, Ortai, Zhang Tingyu, and others were assigned Miao frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書巴泰褫職。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Batai was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Batai was stripped of his post.

sentences.zh: 命刑部尚書張照、副都御史德希壽稽勘苗疆事務。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Zhang Zhao and Vice Censor-in-chief De Xishou were ordered to investigate and inspect Miao frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhao and De Xishou were sent to audit Miao frontier administration.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，哈元生奏剿辦逆苗，黃平、施秉悉平。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Ha Yuansheng memorialized on suppressing rebellious Miao; Huangping and Shibing were wholly pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Ha Yuansheng reported Huangping and Shibing pacified.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，敕戶部清查各省耗羨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to investigate surcharges in all provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to audit provincial surcharges.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以查克旦為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Chake'dan was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Chake'dan became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 甲申，准土司由生員出身者一體應試。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, native chiefs who had risen from licentiate student status were permitted to take examinations on equal terms.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, student-born native chiefs were allowed to sit civil examinations like others.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，減各省進獻方物。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, tribute goods presented from all provinces were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, provincial tribute offerings were cut back.

sentences.zh: 呂宋國飢，請糴。

translations.literal: The Luzon state was famine-stricken and asked to buy grain.
translations.idiomatic: Luzon, suffering famine, requested to purchase grain.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: This was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命董芳為副將軍，協剿苗匪。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Dong Fang was ordered as vice general to assist in suppressing Miao bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Dong Fang was made vice general to help suppress Miao rebels.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，鄂爾泰請辭伯爵、大學士。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yimao: Ortai asked to resign his earldom and grand secretaryship.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Ortai asked to give up his earldom and grand secretary post.

sentences.zh: 許之，給假養病，仍食俸。

translations.literal: This was granted; leave to nurse illness was given while salary continued.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed; he was granted sick leave but kept his salary.

sentences.zh: 署甘州提督劉世明以失察兵丁搶劫論斬。

translations.literal: Acting Gansu Provincial Commander Liu Shiming, for failure to detect soldiers' robbery, was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Gansu commander Liu Shiming was sentenced to death for not detecting troop robbery.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命朱軾往勘浙江海塘。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zhu Shi was ordered to go inspect Zhejiang seawalls.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Zhu Shi was sent to survey Zhejiang's sea dikes.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以邁柱、查郎阿為大學士，張廣泗為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Mai Zhu and Cha Lang'a were made Grand Secretaries; Zhang Guangsi was made governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Mai Zhu and Cha Lang'a became Grand Secretaries and Zhang Guangsi Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，詔曰：「從前經理苗疆，本為乂安民生。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi, an edict said: "In former management of the Miao frontier, the aim was altogether to pacify the people's lives.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, an edict said Miao administration had been meant to secure the people.

sentences.zh: 乃經理不善，以致逆苗肆出，勾結熟苗，搶劫居民。

translations.literal: Yet poor management caused rebellious Miao to burst forth, colluding with subdued Miao and plundering residents.
translations.idiomatic: Poor management had let rebels ally with pacified Miao and raid the populace.

sentences.zh: 是以安民之心，成虐民之政。

translations.literal: Thus the mind to secure the people became a policy that abused them.
translations.idiomatic: Intent to comfort the people had turned into oppression.

sentences.zh: 返之初心，能勿愧乎？

translations.literal: Turn back to the original intent—can one not feel shame?
translations.idiomatic: Measured against the original aim, how could one not feel ashamed?

sentences.zh: 所有貴州本年錢糧，通行蠲免。

translations.literal: All of Guizhou's land tax and grain levies for this year are wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou's taxes and grain levies for the year were wholly remitted.

sentences.zh: 其被賊州縣，蠲免三年，以示撫綏捄恤之意。

translations.literal: For districts ravaged by bandits, three years' remission, to show intent to pacify, console, and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit-stricken districts received three years' relief to show care and consolation.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict continued."

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上不豫。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上大漸，宣旨傳位皇四子寶親王弘曆。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor grew critically ill; an edict proclaimed succession to the fourth imperial son, Prince of Bao Hongli.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, gravely ill, he proclaimed succession to Prince of Bao Hongli.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上崩，年五十八。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor died, aged fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor died at fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 是歲十一月丁未，恭上尊諡曰敬天昌運建中表正文武英明寬仁信毅睿聖大孝至誠憲皇帝，廟號世宗。

translations.literal: That year, eleventh month, day dingwei: the posthumous honorific Jingtian Changyun Jianzhong Biaozheng Wenwu Yingming Kuanren Xinyi Ruisheng Daxiao Zhicheng Xian was respectfully submitted; temple name Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the full posthumous title and temple name Shizong were conferred.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年三月，葬泰陵。

translations.literal: Third month of Qianlong 2, interment at Tai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Qianlong 2, he was buried at Tai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 論曰：聖祖政尚寬仁，世宗以嚴明繼之。

translations.literal: The commentators say: The Sagely Ancestor's government prized leniency and benevolence; Shizong succeeded with severity and clarity.
translations.idiomatic: The annalists say Kangxi favored leniency while Yongzheng ruled with severity.

sentences.zh: 論者比於漢之文、景。

translations.literal: Commentators compared them to Han Wendi and Jingdi.
translations.idiomatic: Critics likened the pair to Han Wendi and Jingdi.

sentences.zh: 獨孔懷之誼，疑於未篤。

translations.literal: Only in brotherly affection was there suspicion of want of depth.
translations.idiomatic: Only brotherly affection seemed less than wholehearted.

sentences.zh: 然淮南暴伉，有自取之咎，不盡出於文帝之寡恩也。

translations.literal: Yet the Prince of Huainan's violence and arrogance carried fault of his own making—not entirely from Wendi's scant kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Prince of Huainan's arrogance invited his fall—not wholly Wendi's coldness.

sentences.zh: 帝研求治道，尤患下吏之疲睏。

translations.literal: The Emperor studied the art of rule and especially worried over lower officials' exhaustion and distress.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor studied governance and especially pitied overworked local officials.

sentences.zh: 有近臣言州縣所入多，宜釐剔。

translations.literal: A close minister said prefectural and district income was great and ought to be trimmed.
translations.idiomatic: A favorite urged cutting back what prefectures and districts collected.

sentences.zh: 斥之曰：「爾未為州縣，惡知州縣之難？

translations.literal: He rebuked him, saying: "You have never served as prefect or magistrate—how would you know their hardship?
translations.idiomatic: He snapped: "You have never been a magistrate—how would you know their difficulty?"

sentences.zh: 」至哉言乎，可謂知政要矣！

translations.literal: " What sublime words—these show true grasp of governing essentials!
translations.idiomatic: What words—proof he understood the essentials of rule!
